tr: τις στρατευεται ιδιοις οψωνιοις ποτε τις φυτευει αμπελωνα και εκ του καρπου αυτου ουκ εσθιει η τις ποιμαινει ποιμνην και εκ του γαλακτος της ποιμνης ουκ εσθιει
kjv: Who goeth a warfare any time at his own charges? who planteth a vineyard, and eateth not of the fruit thereof? or who feedeth a flock, and eateth not of the milk of the flock?

vulg: numquid secundum hominem haec dico an et lex haec non dicit
clem: Numquid secundum hominem hc dico? an et lex hc non dicit?
tr: μη κατα ανθρωπον ταυτα λαλω η ουχι και ο νομος ταυτα λεγει
kjv: Say I these things as a man? or saith not the law the same also?

vulg: scriptum est enim in lege Mosi non alligabis os bovi trituranti numquid de bubus cura est Deo
clem: Scriptum est enim in lege Moysi: Non alligabis os bovi trituranti. Numquid de bobus cura est Deo?
tr: εν γαρ τω μωσεως νομω γεγραπται ου φιμωσεις βουν αλοωντα μη των βοων μελει τω θεω
kjv: For it is written in the law of Moses, thou shalt not muzzle the mouth of the ox that treadeth out the corn. Doth God take care for oxen?

vulg: an propter nos utique dicit nam propter nos scripta sunt quoniam debet in spe qui arat arare et qui triturat in spe fructus percipiendi
clem: an propter nos utique hoc dicit? Nam propter nos scripta sunt: quoniam debet in spe qui arat, arare: et qui triturat, in spe fructus percipiendi.
tr: η δι ημας παντως λεγει δι ημας γαρ εγραφη οτι επ ελπιδι οφειλει ο αροτριων αροτριαν και ο αλοων της ελπιδος αυτου μετεχειν επ ελπιδι
kjv: Or saith he it altogether for our sakes? For our sakes, no doubt, this is written: that he that ploweth should plow in hope; and that he that thresheth in hope should be partaker of his hope.

vulg: si nos vobis spiritalia seminavimus magnum est si nos carnalia vestra metamus
clem: Si nos vobis spiritualia seminavimus, magnum est si nos carnalia vestra metamus?
tr: ει ημεις υμιν τα πνευματικα εσπειραμεν μεγα ει ημεις υμων τα σαρκικα θερισομεν
kjv: If we have sown unto you spiritual things, is it a great thing if we shall reap your carnal things?

vulg: si alii potestatis vestrae participes sunt non potius nos sed non usi sumus hac potestate sed omnia sustinemus ne quod offendiculum demus evangelio Christi
clem: Si alii potestatis vestr participes sunt, quare non potius nos? Sed non usi sumus hac potestate: sed omnia sustinemus, ne quod offendiculum demus Evangelio Christi.
tr: ει αλλοι της εξουσιας υμων μετεχουσιν ου μαλλον ημεις αλλ ουκ εχρησαμεθα τη εξουσια ταυτη αλλα παντα στεγομεν ινα μη εγκοπην τινα δωμεν τω ευαγγελιω του χριστου
kjv: If others be partakers of this power over you, are not we rather? Nevertheless we have not used this power; but suffer all things, lest we should hinder the gospel of Christ.

vulg: nescitis quoniam qui in sacrario operantur quae de sacrario sunt edunt qui altario deserviunt cum altario participantur
clem: Nescitis quoniam qui in sacrario operantur qu de sacrario sunt, edunt: et qui altari deserviunt, cum altari participant?
tr: ουκ οιδατε οτι οι τα ιερα εργαζομενοι εκ του ιερου εσθιουσιν οι τω θυσιαστηριω προσεδρευοντες τω θυσιαστηριω συμμεριζονται
kjv: Do ye not know that they which minister about holy things live of the things of the temple? and they which wait at the altar are partakers with the altar?

vulg: ita et Dominus ordinavit his qui evangelium adnuntiant de evangelio vivere
clem: Ita et Dominus ordinavit iis qui Evangelium annuntiant, de Evangelio vivere.
tr: ουτως και ο κυριος διεταξεν τοις το ευαγγελιον καταγγελλουσιν εκ του ευαγγελιου ζην
kjv: Even so hath the Lord ordained that they which preach the gospel should live of the gospel.

vulg: ego autem nullo horum usus sum non scripsi autem haec ut ita fiant in me bonum est enim mihi magis mori quam ut gloriam meam quis evacuet
clem: Ego autem nullo horum usus sum. Non autem scripsi hc ut ita fiant in me: bonum est enim mihi magis mori, quam ut gloriam meam quis evacuet.
tr: εγω δε ουδενι εχρησαμην τουτων ουκ εγραψα δε ταυτα ινα ουτως γενηται εν εμοι καλον γαρ μοι μαλλον αποθανειν η το καυχημα μου ινα τις κενωση
kjv: But I have used none of these things: neither have I written these things, that it should be so done unto me: for it were better for me to die, than that any man should make my glorying void.

vulg: nam si evangelizavero non est mihi gloria necessitas enim mihi incumbit vae enim mihi est si non evangelizavero
clem: Nam si evangelizavero, non est mihi gloria: necessitas enim mihi incumbit: v enim mihi est, si non evangelizavero.
tr: εαν γαρ ευαγγελιζωμαι ουκ εστιν μοι καυχημα αναγκη γαρ μοι επικειται ουαι δε μοι εστιν εαν μη ευαγγελιζωμαι
kjv: For though I preach the gospel, I have nothing to glory of: for necessity is laid upon me; yea, woe is unto me, if I preach not the gospel!

vulg: si enim volens hoc ago mercedem habeo si autem invitus dispensatio mihi credita est
clem: Si enim volens hoc ago, mercedem habeo: si autem invitus, dispensatio mihi credita est.
tr: ει γαρ εκων τουτο πρασσω μισθον εχω ει δε ακων οικονομιαν πεπιστευμαι
kjv: For if I do this thing willingly, I have a reward: but if against my will, a dispensation of the gospel is committed unto me.

vulg: quae est ergo merces mea ut evangelium praedicans sine sumptu ponam evangelium ut non abutar potestate mea in evangelio
clem: Qu est ergo merces mea? ut Evangelium prdicans, sine sumptu ponam Evangelium, ut non abutar potestate mea in Evangelio.
tr: τις ουν μοι εστιν ο μισθος ινα ευαγγελιζομενος αδαπανον θησω το ευαγγελιον του χριστου εις το μη καταχρησασθαι τη εξουσια μου εν τω ευαγγελιω
kjv: What is my reward then? Verily that, when I preach the gospel, I may make the gospel of Christ without charge, that I abuse not my power in the gospel.

vulg: nam cum liber essem ex omnibus omnium me servum feci ut plures lucri facerem
clem: Nam cum liber essem ex omnibus, omnium me servum feci, ut plures lucrifacerem.
tr: ελευθερος γαρ ων εκ παντων πασιν εμαυτον εδουλωσα ινα τους πλειονας κερδησω
kjv: For though I be free from all men, yet have I made myself servant unto all, that I might gain the more.

vulg: et factus sum Iudaeis tamquam Iudaeus ut Iudaeos lucrarer
clem: Et factus sum Judis tamquam Judus, ut Judos lucrarer:
tr: και εγενομην τοις ιουδαιοις ως ιουδαιος ινα ιουδαιους κερδησω τοις υπο νομον ως υπο νομον ινα τους υπο νομον κερδησω
kjv: And unto the Jews I became as a Jew, that I might gain the Jews; to them that are under the law, as under the law, that I might gain them that are under the law;

vulg: his qui sub lege sunt quasi sub lege essem cum ipse non essem sub lege ut eos qui sub lege erant lucri facerem his qui sine lege erant tamquam sine lege essem cum sine lege Dei non essem sed in lege essem Christi ut lucri facerem eos qui sine lege erant
clem: iis qui sub lege sunt, quasi sub lege essem (cum ipse non essem sub lege) ut eos qui sub lege erant, lucrifacerem: iis qui sine lege erant, tamquam sine lege essem (cum sine lege Dei non essem: sed in lege essem Christi) ut lucrifacerem eos qui sine lege erant.
tr: τοις ανομοις ως ανομος μη ων ανομος θεω αλλ εννομος χριστω ινα κερδησω ανομους
kjv: To them that are without law, as without law, (being not without law to God, but under the law to Christ,) that I might gain them that are without law.

vulg: factus sum infirmis infirmus ut infirmos lucri facerem omnibus omnia factus sum ut omnes facerem salvos
clem: Factus sum infirmis infirmus, ut infirmos lucrifacerem. Omnibus omnia factus sum, ut omnes facerem salvos.
tr: εγενομην τοις ασθενεσιν ως ασθενης ινα τους ασθενεις κερδησω τοις πασιν γεγονα τα παντα ινα παντως τινας σωσω
kjv: To the weak became I as weak, that I might gain the weak: I am made all things to all men, that I might by all means save some.

vulg: omnia autem facio propter evangelium ut particeps eius efficiar
clem: Omnia autem facio propter Evangelium: ut particeps ejus efficiar.
tr: τουτο δε ποιω δια το ευαγγελιον ινα συγκοινωνος αυτου γενωμαι
kjv: And this I do for the gospel's sake, that I might be partaker thereof with you.

vulg: nescitis quod hii qui in stadio currunt omnes quidem currunt sed unus accipit bravium sic currite ut conprehendatis
clem: Nescitis quod ii qui in stadio currunt, omnes quidem currunt, sed unus accipit bravium? Sic currite ut comprehendatis.
tr: ουκ οιδατε οτι οι εν σταδιω τρεχοντες παντες μεν τρεχουσιν εις δε λαμβανει το βραβειον ουτως τρεχετε ινα καταλαβητε
kjv: Know ye not that they which run in a race run all, but one receiveth the prize? So run, that ye may obtain.

vulg: omnis autem qui in agone contendit ab omnibus se abstinet et illi quidem ut corruptibilem coronam accipiant nos autem incorruptam
clem: Omnis autem qui in agone contendit, ab omnibus se abstinet, et illi quidem ut corruptibilem coronam accipiant: nos autem incorruptam.
tr: πας δε ο αγωνιζομενος παντα εγκρατευεται εκεινοι μεν ουν ινα φθαρτον στεφανον λαβωσιν ημεις δε αφθαρτον
kjv: And every man that striveth for the mastery is temperate in all things. Now they do it to obtain a corruptible crown; but we an incorruptible.

vulg: ego igitur sic curro non quasi in incertum sic pugno non quasi aerem verberans
clem: Ego igitur sic curro, non quasi in incertum: sic pugno, non quasi arem verberans:
tr: εγω τοινυν ουτως τρεχω ως ουκ αδηλως ουτως πυκτευω ως ουκ αερα δερων
kjv: I therefore so run, not as uncertainly; so fight I, not as one that beateth the air:

vulg: sed castigo corpus meum et in servitutem redigo ne forte cum aliis praedicaverim ipse reprobus efficiar
clem: sed castigo corpus meum, et in servitutem redigo: ne forte cum aliis prdicaverim, ipse reprobus efficiar.
tr: αλλ υπωπιαζω μου το σωμα και δουλαγωγω μηπως αλλοις κηρυξας αυτος αδοκιμος γενωμαι
kjv: But I keep under my body, and bring it into subjection: lest that by any means, when I have preached to others, I myself should be a castaway.

vulg: nolo enim vos ignorare fratres quoniam patres nostri omnes sub nube fuerunt et omnes mare transierunt
clem: Nolo enim vos ignorare fratres, quoniam patres nostri omnes sub nube fuerunt, et omnes mare transierunt,
tr: ου θελω δε υμας αγνοειν αδελφοι οτι οι πατερες ημων παντες υπο την νεφελην ησαν και παντες δια της θαλασσης διηλθον
kjv: Moreover, brethren, I would not that ye should be ignorant, how that all our fathers were under the cloud, and all passed through the sea;

vulg: et omnes in Mose baptizati sunt in nube et in mari
clem: et omnes in Moyse baptizati sunt in nube, et in mari:
tr: και παντες εις τον μωσην εβαπτισαντο εν τη νεφελη και εν τη θαλασση
kjv: And were all baptized unto Moses in the cloud and in the sea;

vulg: et omnes eandem escam spiritalem manducaverunt
clem: et omnes eamdem escam spiritalem manducaverunt,
tr: και παντες το αυτο βρωμα πνευματικον εφαγον
kjv: And did all eat the same spiritual meat;

vulg: et omnes eundem potum spiritalem biberunt bibebant autem de spiritali consequenti eos petra petra autem erat Christus
clem: et omnes eumdem potum spiritalem biberunt (bibebant autem de spiritali, consequente eos, petra: petra autem erat Christus):
tr: και παντες το αυτο πομα πνευματικον επιον επινον γαρ εκ πνευματικης ακολουθουσης πετρας η δε πετρα ην ο χριστος
kjv: And did all drink the same spiritual drink: for they drank of that spiritual Rock that followed them: and that Rock was Christ.

vulg: sed non in pluribus eorum beneplacitum est Deo nam prostrati sunt in deserto
clem: sed non in pluribus eorum beneplacitum est Deo: nam prostrati sunt in deserto.
tr: αλλ ουκ εν τοις πλειοσιν αυτων ευδοκησεν ο θεος κατεστρωθησαν γαρ εν τη ερημω
kjv: But with many of them God was not well pleased: for they were overthrown in the wilderness.

vulg: haec autem in figura facta sunt nostri ut non simus concupiscentes malorum sicut et illi concupierunt
clem: Hc autem in figura facta sunt nostri, ut non simus concupiscentes malorum, sicut et illi concupierunt.
tr: ταυτα δε τυποι ημων εγενηθησαν εις το μη ειναι ημας επιθυμητας κακων καθως κακεινοι επεθυμησαν
kjv: Now these things were our examples, to the intent we should not lust after evil things, as they also lusted.

vulg: neque idolorum cultores efficiamini sicut quidam ex ipsis quemadmodum scriptum est sedit populus manducare et bibere et surrexerunt ludere
clem: Neque idololatr efficiamini, sicut quidam ex ipsis: quemadmodum scriptum est: Sedit populus manducare, et bibere, et surrexerunt ludere.
tr: μηδε ειδωλολατραι γινεσθε καθως τινες αυτων ως γεγραπται εκαθισεν ο λαος φαγειν και πιειν και ανεστησαν παιζειν
kjv: Neither be ye idolaters, as were some of them; as it is written, The people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play.

vulg: neque fornicemur sicut quidam ex ipsis fornicati sunt et ceciderunt una die viginti tria milia
clem: Neque fornicemur, sicut quidam ex ipsis fornicati sunt, et ceciderunt una die viginti tria millia.
tr: μηδε πορνευωμεν καθως τινες αυτων επορνευσαν 4203 και επεσον εν μια ημερα εικοσιτρεις  χιλιαδες
kjv: Neither let us commit fornication, as some of them committed, and fell in one day three and twenty thousand.

vulg: neque temptemus Christum sicut quidam eorum temptaverunt et a serpentibus perierunt
clem: Neque tentemus Christum, sicut quidam eorum tentaverunt, et a serpentibus perierunt.
tr: μηδε εκπειραζωμεν τον χριστον καθως και τινες αυτων επειρασαν και υπο των οφεων απωλοντο
kjv: Neither let us tempt Christ, as some of them also tempted, and were destroyed of serpents.

vulg: neque murmuraveritis sicut quidam eorum murmuraverunt et perierunt ab exterminatore
clem: Neque murmuraveritis, sicut quidam eorum murmuraverunt, et perierunt ab exterminatore.
tr: μηδε γογγυζετε καθως και τινες αυτων εγογγυσαν και απωλοντο υπο του ολοθρευτου
kjv: Neither murmur ye, as some of them also murmured, and were destroyed of the destroyer.

vulg: haec autem omnia in figura contingebant illis scripta sunt autem ad correptionem nostram in quos fines saeculorum devenerunt
clem: Hc autem omnia in figura contingebant illis: scripta sunt autem ad correptionem nostram, in quos fines sculorum devenerunt.
tr: ταυτα δε παντα τυποι συνεβαινον εκεινοις εγραφη δε προς νουθεσιαν ημων εις ους τα τελη των αιωνων κατηντησεν
kjv: Now all these things happened unto them for examples: and they are written for our admonition, upon whom the ends of the world are come.

vulg: itaque qui se existimat stare videat ne cadat
clem: Itaque qui se existimat stare, videat ne cadat.
tr: ωστε ο δοκων εσταναι βλεπετω μη πεση
kjv: Wherefore let him that thinketh he standeth take heed lest he fall.

vulg: temptatio vos non adprehendat nisi humana fidelis autem Deus qui non patietur vos temptari super id quod potestis sed faciet cum temptatione etiam proventum ut possitis sustinere
clem: Tentatio vos non apprehendat nisi humana: fidelis autem Deus est, qui non patietur vos tentari supra id quod potestis, sed faciet etiam cum tentatione proventum ut possitis sustinere.
tr: πειρασμος υμας ουκ ειληφεν ει μη ανθρωπινος πιστος δε ο θεος ος ουκ εασει υμας πειρασθηναι υπερ ο δυνασθε αλλα ποιησει συν τω πειρασμω και την εκβασιν του δυνασθαι υμας υπενεγκειν
kjv: There hath no temptation taken you but such as is common to man: but God is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape, that ye may be able to bear it.

vulg: propter quod carissimi mihi fugite ab idolorum cultura
clem: Propter quod, carissimi mihi, fugite ab idolorum cultura:
tr: διοπερ αγαπητοι μου φευγετε απο της ειδωλολατρειας
kjv: Wherefore, my dearly beloved, flee from idolatry.

vulg: ut prudentibus loquor vos iudicate quod dico
clem: ut prudentibus loquor, vos ipsi judicate quod dico.
tr: ως φρονιμοις λεγω κρινατε υμεις ο φημι
kjv: I speak as to wise men; judge ye what I say.

vulg: calicem benedictionis cui benedicimus nonne communicatio sanguinis Christi est et panis quem frangimus nonne participatio corporis Domini est
clem: Calix benedictionis, cui benedicimus, nonne communicatio sanguinis Christi est? et panis quem frangimus, nonne participatio corporis Domini est?
tr: το ποτηριον της ευλογιας ο ευλογουμεν ουχι κοινωνια του αιματος του χριστου εστιν τον αρτον ον κλωμεν ουχι κοινωνια του σωματος του χριστου εστιν
kjv: The cup of blessing which we bless, is it not the communion of the blood of Christ? The bread which we break, is it not the communion of the body of Christ?

vulg: quoniam unus panis unum corpus multi sumus omnes quidem de uno pane participamur
clem: Quoniam unus panis, unum corpus multi sumus, omnes qui de uno pane participamus.
tr: οτι εις αρτος εν σωμα οι πολλοι εσμεν οι γαρ παντες εκ του ενος αρτου μετεχομεν
kjv: For we being many are one bread, and one body: for we are all partakers of that one bread.

vulg: videte Israhel secundum carnem nonne qui edunt hostias participes sunt altaris
clem: Videte Isral secundum carnem: nonne qui edunt hostias, participes sunt altaris?
tr: βλεπετε τον ισραηλ κατα σαρκα ουχι οι εσθιοντες τας θυσιας κοινωνοι του θυσιαστηριου εισιν
kjv: Behold Israel after the flesh: are not they which eat of the sacrifices partakers of the altar?

vulg: quid ergo dico quod idolis immolatum sit aliquid aut quod idolum sit aliquid
clem: Quid ergo? dico quod idolis immolatum sit aliquid? aut quod idolum, sit aliquid?
tr: τι ουν φημι οτι ειδωλον τι εστιν η οτι ειδωλοθυτον τι εστιν
kjv: What say I then? that the idol is any thing, or that which is offered in sacrifice to idols is any thing?

vulg: sed quae immolant gentes daemoniis immolant et non Deo nolo autem vos socios fieri daemoniorum non potestis calicem Domini bibere et calicem daemoniorum
clem: Sed qu immolant gentes, dmoniis immolant, et non Deo. Nolo autem vos socios fieri dmoniorum:
tr: αλλ οτι α θυει τα εθνη δαιμονιοις θυει και ου θεω ου θελω δε υμας κοινωνους των δαιμονιων γινεσθαι
kjv: But I say, that the things which the Gentiles sacrifice, they sacrifice to devils, and not to God: and I would not that ye should have fellowship with devils.

vulg: non potestis mensae Domini participes esse et mensae daemoniorum
clem: non potestis calicem Domini bibere, et calicem dmoniorum; non potestis mens Domini participes esse, et mens dmoniorum.
tr: ου δυνασθε ποτηριον κυριου πινειν και ποτηριον δαιμονιων ου δυνασθε τραπεζης κυριου μετεχειν και τραπεζης δαιμονιων
kjv: Ye cannot drink the cup of the Lord, and the cup of devils: ye cannot be partakers of the Lord's table, and of the table of devils.

vulg: an aemulamur Dominum numquid fortiores illo sumus omnia licent sed non omnia expediunt
clem: An mulamur Dominum? numquid fortiores illo sumus? Omnia mihi licent, sed non omnia expediunt.
tr: η παραζηλουμεν τον κυριον μη ισχυροτεροι αυτου εσμεν
kjv: Do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? are we stronger than he?

vulg: omnia licent sed non omnia aedificant
clem: Omnia mihi licent, sed non omnia dificat.
tr: παντα μοι εξεστιν αλλ ου παντα συμφερει παντα μοι εξεστιν αλλ ου παντα οικοδομει
kjv: All things are lawful for me, but all things are not expedient: all things are lawful for me, but all things edify not.

vulg: nemo quod suum est quaerat sed quod alterius
clem: Nemo quod suum est qurat, sed quod alterius.
tr: μηδεις το εαυτου ζητειτω αλλα το του ετερου εκαστος
kjv: Let no man seek his own, but every man another's wealth.

vulg: omne quod in macello venit manducate nihil interrogantes propter conscientiam
clem: Omne quod in macello venit, manducate, nihil interrogantes propter conscientiam.
tr: παν το εν μακελλω πωλουμενον εσθιετε μηδεν ανακρινοντες δια την συνειδησιν
kjv: Whatsoever is sold in the shambles, that eat, asking no question for conscience sake:

vulg: Domini est terra et plenitudo eius
clem: Domini est terra, et plenitudo ejus.
tr: του γαρ κυριου η γη και το πληρωμα αυτης
kjv: For the earth is the Lord's, and the fulness thereof.

vulg: si quis vocat vos infidelium et vultis ire omne quod vobis adponitur manducate nihil interrogantes propter conscientiam
clem: Si quis vocat vos infidelium, et vultis ire: omne quod vobis apponitur, manducate, nihil interrogantes propter conscientiam.
tr: ει δε τις καλει υμας των απιστων και θελετε πορευεσθαι παν το παρατιθεμενον υμιν εσθιετε μηδεν ανακρινοντες δια την συνειδησιν
kjv: If any of them that believe not bid you to a feast, and ye be disposed to go; whatsoever is set before you, eat, asking no question for conscience sake.

vulg: si quis autem dixerit hoc immolaticium est idolis nolite manducare propter illum qui indicavit et propter conscientiam
clem: Si quis autem dixerit: Hoc immolatum est idolis: nolite manducare propter illum qui indicavit, et propter conscientiam:
tr: εαν δε τις υμιν ειπη τουτο ειδωλοθυτον εστιν μη εσθιετε δι εκεινον τον μηνυσαντα και την συνειδησιν του γαρ κυριου η γη και το πληρωμα αυτης
kjv: But if any man say unto you, this is offered in sacrifice unto idols, eat not for his sake that shewed it, and for conscience sake: for the earth is the Lord's, and the fulness thereof:

vulg: conscientiam autem dico non tuam sed alterius ut quid enim libertas mea iudicatur ab alia conscientia
clem: conscientiam autem dico non tuam, sed alterius. Ut quid enim libertas mea judicatur ab aliena conscientia?
tr: συνειδησιν δε λεγω ουχι την εαυτου αλλα την του ετερου ινα τι γαρ η ελευθερια μου κρινεται υπο αλλης συνειδησεως
kjv: Conscience, I say, not thine own, but of the other: for why is my liberty judged of another man's conscience?

vulg: si ego cum gratia participo quid blasphemor pro eo quod gratias ago
clem: Si ego cum gratia participo, quid blasphemor pro eo quod gratias ago?
tr: ει δε εγω χαριτι μετεχω τι βλασφημουμαι υπερ ου εγω ευχαριστω
kjv: For if I by grace be a partaker, why am I evil spoken of for that for which I give thanks?

vulg: sive ergo manducatis sive bibitis vel aliud quid facitis omnia in gloriam Dei facite
clem: Sive ergo manducatis, sive bibitis, sive aliud quid facitis: omnia in gloriam Dei facite.
tr: ειτε ουν εσθιετε ειτε πινετε ειτε τι ποιειτε παντα εις δοξαν θεου ποιειτε
kjv: Whether therefore ye eat, or drink, or whatsoever ye do, do all to the glory of God.

vulg: sine offensione estote Iudaeis et gentilibus et ecclesiae Dei
clem: Sine offensione estote Judis, et gentibus, et ecclesi Dei:
tr: απροσκοποι γινεσθε και ιουδαιοις και ελλησιν και τη εκκλησια του θεου
kjv: Give none offence, neither to the Jews, nor to the Gentiles, nor to the church of God:

vulg: sicut et ego per omnia omnibus placeo non quaerens quod mihi utile est sed quod multis ut salvi fiant
clem: sicut et ego per omnia omnibus placeo, non qurens quod mihi utile est, sed quod multis: ut salvi fiant.
tr: καθως καγω παντα πασιν αρεσκω μη ζητων το εμαυτου συμφερον αλλα το των πολλων ινα σωθωσιν
kjv: Even as I please all men in all things, not seeking mine own profit, but the profit of many, that they may be saved.

vulg: imitatores mei estote sicut et ego Christi
clem: Imitatores mei estote, sicut et ego Christi.
tr: μιμηται μου γινεσθε καθως καγω χριστου
kjv: Be ye followers of me, even as I also am of Christ.

vulg: laudo autem vos fratres quod omnia mei memores estis et sicut tradidi vobis praecepta mea tenetis
clem: Laudo autem vos fratres quod per omnia mei memores estis: et sicut tradidi vobis, prcepta mea tenetis.
tr: επαινω δε υμας αδελφοι οτι παντα μου μεμνησθε και καθως παρεδωκα υμιν τας παραδοσεις κατεχετε
kjv: Now I praise you, brethren, that ye remember me in all things, and keep the ordinances, as I delivered them to you.

vulg: volo autem vos scire quod omnis viri caput Christus est caput autem mulieris vir caput vero Christi Deus
clem: Volo autem vos scire quod omnis viri caput, Christus est: caput autem mulieris, vir: caput vero Christi, Deus.
tr: θελω δε υμας ειδεναι οτι παντος ανδρος η κεφαλη ο χριστος εστιν κεφαλη δε γυναικος ο ανηρ κεφαλη δε χριστου ο θεος
kjv: But I would have you know, that the head of every man is Christ; and the head of the woman is the man; and the head of Christ is God.

vulg: omnis vir orans aut prophetans velato capite deturpat caput suum
clem: Omnis vir orans, aut prophetans velato capite, deturpat caput suum.
tr: πας ανηρ προσευχομενος η προφητευων κατα κεφαλης εχων καταισχυνει την κεφαλην αυτου
kjv: Every man praying or prophesying, having his head covered, dishonoureth his head.

vulg: omnis autem mulier orans aut prophetans non velato capite deturpat caput suum unum est enim atque si decalvetur
clem: Omnis autem mulier orans, aut prophetans non velato capite, deturpat caput suum: unum enim est ac si decalvetur.
tr: πασα δε γυνη προσευχομενη η προφητευουσα ακατακαλυπτω τη κεφαλη καταισχυνει την κεφαλην εαυτης εν γαρ εστιν και το αυτο τη εξυρημενη
kjv: But every woman that prayeth or prophesieth with her head uncovered dishonoureth her head: for that is even all one as if she were shaven.

vulg: nam si non velatur mulier et tondeatur si vero turpe est mulieri tonderi aut decalvari velet caput suum
clem: Nam si non velatur mulier, tondeatur. Si vero turpe est mulieri tonderi, aut decalvari, velet caput suum.
tr: ει γαρ ου κατακαλυπτεται γυνη και κειρασθω ει δε αισχρον γυναικι το κειρασθαι η ξυρασθαι κατακαλυπτεσθω
kjv: For if the woman be not covered, let her also be shorn: but if it be a shame for a woman to be shorn or shaven, let her be covered.

vulg: vir quidem non debet velare caput quoniam imago et gloria est Dei mulier autem gloria viri est
clem: Vir quidem non debet velare caput suum: quoniam imago et gloria Dei est, mulier autem gloria viri est.
tr: ανηρ μεν γαρ ουκ οφειλει κατακαλυπτεσθαι την κεφαλην εικων και δοξα θεου υπαρχων γυνη δε δοξα ανδρος εστιν
kjv: For a man indeed ought not to cover his head, forasmuch as he is the image and glory of God: but the woman is the glory of the man.

vulg: non enim vir ex muliere est sed mulier ex viro
clem: Non enim vir ex muliere est, sed mulier ex viro.
tr: ου γαρ εστιν ανηρ εκ γυναικος αλλα γυνη εξ ανδρος
kjv: For the man is not of the woman: but the woman of the man.

vulg: etenim non est creatus vir propter mulierem sed mulier propter virum
clem: Etenim non est creatus vir propter mulierem, sed mulier propter virum.
tr: και γαρ ουκ εκτισθη ανηρ δια την γυναικα αλλα γυνη δια τον ανδρα
kjv: Neither was the man created for the woman; but the woman for the man.

vulg: ideo debet mulier potestatem habere supra caput propter angelos
clem: Ideo debet mulier potestatem habere supra caput propter angelos.
tr: δια τουτο οφειλει η γυνη εξουσιαν εχειν επι της κεφαλης δια τους αγγελους
kjv: For this cause ought the woman to have power on her head because of the angels.

vulg: verumtamen neque vir sine muliere neque mulier sine viro in Domino
clem: Verumtamen neque vir sine muliere: neque mulier sine viro in Domino.
tr: πλην ουτε ανηρ χωρις γυναικος ουτε γυνη χωρις ανδρος εν κυριω
kjv: Nevertheless neither is the man without the woman, neither the woman without the man, in the Lord.

vulg: nam sicut mulier de viro ita et vir per mulierem omnia autem ex Deo
clem: Nam sicut mulier de viro, ita et vir per mulierem: omnia autem ex Deo.
tr: ωσπερ γαρ η γυνη εκ του ανδρος ουτως και ο ανηρ δια της γυναικος τα δε παντα εκ του θεου
kjv: For as the woman is of the man, even so is the man also by the woman; but all things of God.

vulg: vos ipsi iudicate decet mulierem non velatam orare Deum
clem: Vos ipsi judicate: decet mulierem non velatam orare Deum?
tr: εν υμιν αυτοις κρινατε πρεπον εστιν γυναικα ακατακαλυπτον τω θεω προσευχεσθαι
kjv: Judge in yourselves: is it comely that a woman pray unto God uncovered?

vulg: nec ipsa natura docet vos quod vir quidem si comam nutriat ignominia est illi
clem: Nec ipsa natura docet vos, quod vir quidem si comam nutriat, ignominia est illi:
tr: η ουδε αυτη η φυσις διδασκει υμας οτι ανηρ μεν εαν κομα ατιμια αυτω εστιν
kjv: Doth not even nature itself teach you, that, if a man have long hair, it is a shame unto him?

vulg: mulier vero si comam nutriat gloria est illi quoniam capilli pro velamine ei dati sunt
clem: mulier vero si comam nutriat, gloria est illi: quoniam capilli pro velamine ei dati sunt.
tr: γυνη δε εαν κομα δοξα αυτη εστιν οτι η κομη αντι περιβολαιου δεδοται αυτη
kjv: But if a woman have long hair, it is a glory to her: for her hair is given her for a covering.

vulg: si quis autem videtur contentiosus esse nos talem consuetudinem non habemus neque ecclesiae Dei
clem: Si quis autem videtur contentiosus esse: nos talem consuetudinem non habemus, neque ecclesia Dei.
tr: ει δε τις δοκει φιλονεικος ειναι ημεις τοιαυτην συνηθειαν ουκ εχομεν ουδε αι εκκλησιαι του θεου
kjv: But if any man seem to be contentious, we have no such custom, neither the churches of God.

vulg: hoc autem praecipio non laudans quod non in melius sed in deterius convenitis
clem: Hoc autem prcipio: non laudans quod non in melius, sed in deterius convenitis.
tr: τουτο δε παραγγελλων ουκ επαινω οτι ουκ εις το κρειττον αλλ εις το ηττον συνερχεσθε
kjv: Now in this that I declare unto you I praise you not, that ye come together not for the better, but for the worse.

vulg: primum quidem convenientibus vobis in ecclesia audio scissuras esse et ex parte credo
clem: Primum quidem convenientibus vobis in ecclesiam, audio scissuras esse inter vos, et ex parte credo.
tr: πρωτον μεν γαρ συνερχομενων υμων εν τη εκκλησια ακουω σχισματα εν υμιν υπαρχειν και μερος τι πιστευω
kjv: For first of all, when ye come together in the church, I hear that there be divisions among you; and I partly believe it.

vulg: nam oportet et hereses esse ut et qui probati sunt manifesti fiant in vobis
clem: Nam oportet et hreses esse, ut et qui probati sunt, manifesti fiant in vobis.
tr: δει γαρ και αιρεσεις εν υμιν ειναι ινα οι δοκιμοι φανεροι γενωνται εν υμιν
kjv: For there must be also heresies among you, that they which are approved may be made manifest among you.

vulg: convenientibus ergo vobis in unum iam non est dominicam cenam manducare
clem: Convenientibus ergo vobis in unum, jam non est Dominicam cnam manducare.
tr: συνερχομενων ουν υμων επι το αυτο ουκ εστιν κυριακον δειπνον φαγειν
kjv: When ye come together therefore into one place, this is not to eat the Lord's supper.

vulg: unusquisque enim suam cenam praesumit ad manducandum et alius quidem esurit alius autem ebrius est
clem: Unusquisque enim suam cnam prsumit ad manducandum, et alius quidem esurit, alius autem ebrius est.
tr: εκαστος γαρ το ιδιον δειπνον προλαμβανει εν τω φαγειν και ος μεν πεινα ος δε μεθυει
kjv: For in eating every one taketh before other his own supper: and one is hungry, and another is drunken.

vulg: numquid domos non habetis ad manducandum et bibendum aut ecclesiam Dei contemnitis et confunditis eos qui non habent quid dicam vobis laudo vos in hoc non laudo
clem: Numquid domos non habetis ad manducandum, et bibendum? aut ecclesiam Dei contemnitis, et confunditis eos qui non habent? Quid dicam vobis? laudo vos? in hoc non laudo.
tr: μη γαρ οικιας ουκ εχετε εις το εσθιειν και πινειν η της εκκλησιας του θεου καταφρονειτε και καταισχυνετε τους μη εχοντας τι υμιν ειπω επαινεσω υμας εν τουτω ουκ επαινω
kjv: What? have ye not houses to eat and to drink in? or despise ye the church of God, and shame them that have not? what shall I say to you? shall I praise you in this? I praise you not.

vulg: ego enim accepi a Domino quod et tradidi vobis quoniam Dominus Iesus in qua nocte tradebatur accepit panem
clem: Ego enim accepi a Domino quod et tradidi vobis, quoniam Dominus Jesus in qua nocte tradebatur, accepit panem,
tr: εγω γαρ παρελαβον απο του κυριου ο και παρεδωκα υμιν οτι ο κυριος ιησους εν τη νυκτι η παρεδιδοτο ελαβεν αρτον
kjv: For I have received of the Lord that which also I delivered unto you, that the Lord Jesus the same night in which he was betrayed took bread:

vulg: et gratias agens fregit et dixit hoc est corpus meum pro vobis hoc facite in meam commemorationem
clem: et gratias agens fregit, et dixit: Accipite, et manducate: hoc est corpus meum, quod pro vobis tradetur: hoc facite in meam commemorationem.
tr: και ευχαριστησας εκλασεν και ειπεν λαβετε φαγετε τουτο μου εστιν το σωμα το υπερ υμων κλωμενον τουτο ποιειτε εις την εμην αναμνησιν
kjv: And when he had given thanks, he brake it, and said, Take, eat: this is my body, which is broken for you: this do in remembrance of me.

vulg: similiter et calicem postquam cenavit dicens hic calix novum testamentum est in meo sanguine hoc facite quotienscumque bibetis in meam commemorationem
clem: Similiter et calicem, postquam cnavit, dicens: Hic calix novum testamentum est in meo sanguine: hoc facite quotiescumque bibetis, in meam commemorationem.
tr: ωσαυτως και το ποτηριον μετα το δειπνησαι λεγων τουτο το ποτηριον η καινη διαθηκη εστιν εν τω εμω αιματι τουτο ποιειτε οσακις αν πινητε εις την εμην αναμνησιν
kjv: After the same manner also he took the cup, when he had supped, saying, this cup is the new testament in my blood: this do ye, as oft as ye drink it, in remembrance of me.

vulg: quotienscumque enim manducabitis panem hunc et calicem bibetis mortem Domini adnuntiatis donec veniat
clem: Quotiescumque enim manducabitis panem hunc, et calicem bibetis, mortem Domini annuntiabitis donec veniat.
tr: οσακις γαρ αν εσθιητε τον αρτον τουτον και το ποτηριον τουτο πινητε τον θανατον του κυριου καταγγελλετε αχρις ου αν ελθη
kjv: For as often as ye eat this bread, and drink this cup, ye do shew the Lord's death till he come.

vulg: itaque quicumque manducaverit panem vel biberit calicem Domini indigne reus erit corporis et sanguinis Domini
clem: Itaque quicumque manducaverit panem hunc, vel biberit calicem Domini indigne, reus erit corporis et sanguinis Domini.
tr: ωστε ος αν εσθιη τον αρτον τουτον η πινη το ποτηριον του κυριου αναξιως ενοχος εσται του σωματος και αιματος του κυριου
kjv: Wherefore whosoever shall eat this bread, and drink this cup of the Lord, unworthily, shall be guilty of the body and blood of the Lord.

vulg: probet autem se ipsum homo et sic de pane illo edat et de calice bibat
clem: Probet autem seipsum homo: et sic de pane illo edat, et de calice bibat.
tr: δοκιμαζετω δε ανθρωπος εαυτον και ουτως εκ του αρτου εσθιετω και εκ του ποτηριου πινετω
kjv: But let a man examine himself, and so let him eat of that bread, and drink of that cup.

vulg: qui enim manducat et bibit indigne iudicium sibi manducat et bibit non diiudicans corpus
clem: Qui enim manducat et bibit indigne, judicium sibi manducat et bibit, non dijudicans corpus Domini.
tr: ο γαρ εσθιων και πινων αναξιως κριμα εαυτω εσθιει και πινει μη διακρινων το σωμα του κυριου
kjv: For he that eateth and drinketh unworthily, eateth and drinketh damnation to himself, not discerning the Lord's body.

vulg: ideo inter vos multi infirmes et inbecilles et dormiunt multi
clem: Ideo inter vos multi infirmi et imbecilles, et dormiunt multi.
tr: δια τουτο εν υμιν πολλοι ασθενεις και αρρωστοι και κοιμωνται ικανοι
kjv: For this cause many are weak and sickly among you, and many sleep.

vulg: quod si nosmet ipsos diiudicaremus non utique iudicaremur
clem: Quod si nosmetipsos dijudicaremus, non utique judicaremur.
tr: ει γαρ εαυτους διεκρινομεν ουκ αν εκρινομεθα
kjv: For if we would judge ourselves, we should not be judged.

vulg: dum iudicamur autem a Domino corripimur ut non cum hoc mundo damnemur
clem: Dum judicamur autem, a Domino corripimur, ut non cum hoc mundo damnemur.
tr: κρινομενοι δε υπο κυριου παιδευομεθα ινα μη συν τω κοσμω κατακριθωμεν
kjv: But when we are judged, we are chastened of the Lord, that we should not be condemned with the world.

vulg: itaque fratres mei cum convenitis ad manducandum invicem expectate
clem: Itaque fratres mei, cum convenitis ad manducandum, invicem exspectate.
tr: ωστε αδελφοι μου συνερχομενοι εις το φαγειν αλληλους εκδεχεσθε
kjv: Wherefore, my brethren, when ye come together to eat, tarry one for another.

vulg: si quis esurit domi manducet ut non in iudicium conveniatis cetera autem cum venero disponam
clem: Si quis esurit, domi manducet, ut non in judicium conveniatis. Cetera autem, cum venero, disponam.
tr: ει δε τις πεινα εν οικω εσθιετω ινα μη εις κριμα συνερχησθε τα δε λοιπα ως αν ελθω διαταξομαι
kjv: And if any man hunger, let him eat at home; that ye come not together unto condemnation. And the rest will I set in order when I come.

vulg: de spiritalibus autem nolo vos ignorare fratres
clem: De spiritualibus autem, nolo vos ignorare fratres.
tr: περι δε των πνευματικων αδελφοι ου θελω υμας αγνοειν
kjv: Now concerning spiritual gifts, brethren, I would not have you ignorant.

vulg: scitis quoniam cum gentes essetis ad simulacra muta prout ducebamini euntes
clem: Scitis quoniam cum gentes essetis, ad simulacra muta prout ducebamini euntes.
tr: οιδατε οτι εθνη ητε προς τα ειδωλα τα αφωνα ως αν ηγεσθε απαγομενοι
kjv: Ye know that ye were Gentiles, carried away unto these dumb idols, even as ye were led.

vulg: ideo notum vobis facio quod nemo in Spiritu Dei loquens dicit anathema Iesu et nemo potest dicere Dominus Iesus nisi in Spiritu Sancto
clem: Ideo notum vobis facio, quod nemo in Spiritu Dei loquens, dicit anathema Jesu. Et nemo potest dicere, Dominus Jesus, nisi in Spiritu Sancto.
tr: διο γνωριζω υμιν οτι ουδεις εν πνευματι θεου λαλων λεγει αναθεμα ιησουν και ουδεις δυναται ειπειν κυριον ιησουν ει μη εν πνευματι αγιω
kjv: Wherefore I give you to understand, that no man speaking by the Spirit of God calleth Jesus accursed: and that no man can say that Jesus is the Lord, but by the Holy Ghost.

vulg: divisiones vero gratiarum sunt idem autem Spiritus
clem: Divisiones vero gratiarum sunt, idem autem Spiritus:
tr: διαιρεσεις δε χαρισματων εισιν το δε αυτο πνευμα
kjv: Now there are diversities of gifts, but the same Spirit.

vulg: et divisiones ministrationum sunt idem autem Dominus
clem: et divisiones ministrationum sunt, idem autem Dominus:
tr: και διαιρεσεις διακονιων εισιν και ο αυτος κυριος
kjv: And there are differences of administrations, but the same Lord.

vulg: et divisiones operationum sunt idem vero Deus qui operatur omnia in omnibus
clem: et divisiones operationum sunt, idem vero Deus qui operatur omnia in omnibus.
tr: και διαιρεσεις ενεργηματων εισιν ο δε αυτος εστιν θεος ο ενεργων τα παντα εν πασιν
kjv: And there are diversities of operations, but it is the same God which worketh all in all.

vulg: unicuique autem datur manifestatio Spiritus ad utilitatem
clem: Unicuique autem datur manifestatio Spiritus ad utilitatem.
tr: εκαστω δε διδοται η φανερωσις του πνευματος προς το συμφερον
kjv: But the manifestation of the Spirit is given to every man to profit withal.

vulg: alii quidem per Spiritum datur sermo sapientiae alii autem sermo scientiae secundum eundem Spiritum
clem: Alii quidem per Spiritum datur sermo sapienti: alii autem sermo scienti secundum eumdem Spiritum:
tr: ω μεν γαρ δια του πνευματος διδοται λογος σοφιας αλλω δε λογος γνωσεως κατα το αυτο πνευμα
kjv: For to one is given by the Spirit the word of wisdom; to another the word of knowledge by the same Spirit;

vulg: alteri fides in eodem Spiritu alii gratia sanitatum in uno Spiritu
clem: alteri fides in eodem Spiritu: alii gratia sanitatum in uno Spiritu:
tr: ετερω δε πιστις εν τω αυτω πνευματι αλλω δε χαρισματα ιαματων εν τω αυτω πνευματι
kjv: To another faith by the same Spirit; to another the gifts of healing by the same Spirit;

vulg: alii operatio virtutum alii prophetatio alii discretio spirituum alii genera linguarum alii interpretatio sermonum
clem: alii operatio virtutum, alii prophetia, alii discretio spirituum, alii genera linguarum, alii interpretatio sermonum.
tr: αλλω δε ενεργηματα δυναμεων αλλω δε προφητεια αλλω δε διακρισεις πνευματων ετερω δε γενη γλωσσων αλλω δε ερμηνεια γλωσσων
kjv: To another the working of miracles; to another prophecy; to another discerning of spirits; to another divers kinds of tongues; to another the interpretation of tongues:

vulg: haec autem omnia operatur unus atque idem Spiritus dividens singulis prout vult
clem: Hc autem omnia operantur unus atque idem Spiritus, dividens singulis prout vult.
tr: παντα δε ταυτα ενεργει το εν και το αυτο πνευμα διαιρουν ιδια εκαστω καθως βουλεται
kjv: But all these worketh that one and the selfsame Spirit, dividing to every man severally as he will.

vulg: sicut enim corpus unum est et membra habet multa omnia autem membra corporis cum sint multa unum corpus sunt ita et Christus
clem: Sicut enim corpus unum est, et membra habet multa, omnia autem membra corporis cum sint multa, unum tamen corpus sunt: ita et Christus.
tr: καθαπερ γαρ το σωμα εν εστιν και μελη εχει πολλα παντα δε τα μελη του σωματος του ενος πολλα οντα εν εστιν σωμα ουτως και ο χριστος
kjv: For as the body is one, and hath many members, and all the members of that one body, being many, are one body: so also is Christ.

vulg: etenim in uno Spiritu omnes nos in unum corpus baptizati sumus sive Iudaei sive gentiles sive servi sive liberi et omnes unum Spiritum potati sumus
clem: Etenim in uno Spiritu omnes nos in unum corpus baptizati sumus, sive Judi, sive gentiles, sive servi, sive liberi: et omnes in uno Spiritu potati sumus.
tr: και γαρ εν ενι πνευματι ημεις παντες εις εν σωμα εβαπτισθημεν ειτε ιουδαιοι ειτε ελληνες ειτε δουλοι ειτε ελευθεροι και παντες εις εν πνευμα εποτισθημεν
kjv: For by one Spirit are we all baptized into one body, whether we be Jews or Gentiles, whether we be bond or free; and have been all made to drink into one Spirit.

vulg: nam et corpus non est unum membrum sed multa
clem: Nam et corpus non est unum membrum, sed multa.
tr: και γαρ το σωμα ουκ εστιν εν μελος αλλα πολλα
kjv: For the body is not one member, but many.

vulg: si dixerit pes quoniam non sum manus non sum de corpore non ideo non est de corpore
clem: Si dixerit pes: Quoniam non sum manus, non sum de corpore: num ideo non est de corpore?
tr: εαν ειπη ο πους οτι ουκ ειμι χειρ ουκ ειμι εκ του σωματος ου παρα τουτο ουκ εστιν εκ του σωματος
kjv: If the foot shall say, Because I am not the hand, I am not of the body; is it therefore not of the body?

vulg: et si dixerit auris quia non sum oculus non sum de corpore non ideo non est de corpore
clem: Et si dixerit auris: Quoniam non sum oculus, non sum de corpore: num ideo est de corpore?
tr: και εαν ειπη το ους οτι ουκ ειμι οφθαλμος ουκ ειμι εκ του σωματος ου παρα τουτο ουκ εστιν εκ του σωματος
kjv: And if the ear shall say, Because I am not the eye, I am not of the body; is it therefore not of the body?

vulg: si totum corpus oculus ubi auditus si totum auditus ubi odoratus
clem: Si totum corpus oculus: ubi auditus? Si totum auditus: ubi odoratus?
tr: ει ολον το σωμα οφθαλμος που η ακοη ει ολον ακοη που η οσφρησις
kjv: If the whole body were an eye, where were the hearing? If the whole were hearing, where were the smelling?

vulg: nunc autem posuit Deus membra unumquodque eorum in corpore sicut voluit
clem: Nunc autem posuit Deus membra, unumquodque eorum in corpore sicut voluit.
tr: νυνι δε ο θεος εθετο τα μελη εν εκαστον αυτων εν τω σωματι καθως ηθελησεν
kjv: But now hath God set the members every one of them in the body, as it hath pleased him.

vulg: quod si essent omnia unum membrum ubi corpus
clem: Quod si essent omnia unum membrum, ubi corpus?
tr: ει δε ην τα παντα εν μελος που το σωμα
kjv: And if they were all one member, where were the body?

vulg: nunc autem multa quidem membra unum autem corpus
clem: Nunc autem multa quidem membra, unum autem corpus.
tr: νυν δε πολλα μεν μελη εν δε σωμα
kjv: But now are they many members, yet but one body.

vulg: non potest dicere oculus manui opera tua non indigeo aut iterum caput pedibus non estis mihi necessarii
clem: Non potest autem oculus dicere manui: Opera tua non indigeo: aut iterum caput pedibus: Non estis mihi necessarii.
tr: ου δυναται δε οφθαλμος ειπειν τη χειρι χρειαν σου ουκ εχω η παλιν η κεφαλη τοις ποσιν χρειαν υμων ουκ εχω
kjv: And the eye cannot say unto the hand, I have no need of thee: nor again the head to the feet, I have no need of you.

vulg: sed multo magis quae videntur membra corporis infirmiora esse necessariora sunt
clem: Sed multo magis qu videntur membra corporis infirmiora esse, necessariora sunt:
tr: αλλα πολλω μαλλον τα δοκουντα μελη του σωματος ασθενεστερα υπαρχειν αναγκαια εστιν
kjv: Nay, much more those members of the body, which seem to be more feeble, are necessary:

vulg: et quae putamus ignobiliora membra esse corporis his honorem abundantiorem circumdamus et quae inhonesta sunt nostra abundantiorem honestatem habent
clem: et qu putamus ignobiliora membra esse corporis, his honorem abundantiorem circumdamus: et qu inhonesta sunt nostra, abundantiorem honestatem habent.
tr: και α δοκουμεν ατιμοτερα ειναι του σωματος τουτοις τιμην περισσοτεραν περιτιθεμεν και τα ασχημονα ημων ευσχημοσυνην περισσοτεραν εχει
kjv: And those members of the body, which we think to be less honourable, upon these we bestow more abundant honour; and our uncomely parts have more abundant comeliness.

vulg: honesta autem nostra nullius egent sed Deus temperavit corpus ei cui deerat abundantiorem tribuendo honorem
clem: Honesta autem nostra nullius egent: sed Deus temperavit corpus, ei cui deerat, abundationem tribuendo honorem,
tr: τα δε ευσχημονα ημων ου χρειαν εχει αλλ ο θεος συνεκερασεν το σωμα τω υστερουντι περισσοτεραν δους τιμην
kjv: For our comely parts have no need: but God hath tempered the body together, having given more abundant honour to that part which lacked.

vulg: ut non sit scisma in corpore sed id ipsum pro invicem sollicita sint membra
clem: ut non sit schisma in corpore, sed idipsum pro invicem sollicita sint membra.
tr: ινα μη η σχισμα εν τω σωματι αλλα το αυτο υπερ αλληλων μεριμνωσιν τα μελη
kjv: That there should be no schism in the body; but that the members should have the same care one for another.

vulg: et si quid patitur unum membrum conpatiuntur omnia membra sive gloriatur unum membrum congaudent omnia membra
clem: Et si quid patitur unum membrum, compatiuntur omnia membra: sive gloriatur unum membrum, congaudent omnia membra.
tr: και ειτε πασχει εν μελος συμπασχει παντα τα μελη ειτε δοξαζεται εν μελος συγχαιρει παντα τα μελη
kjv: And whether one member suffer, all the members suffer with it; or one member be honoured, all the members rejoice with it.

vulg: vos autem estis corpus Christi et membra de membro
clem: Vos autem estis corpus Christi, et membra de membro.
tr: υμεις δε εστε σωμα χριστου και μελη εκ μερους
kjv: Now ye are the body of Christ, and members in particular.

vulg: et quosdam quidem posuit Deus in ecclesia primum apostolos secundo prophetas tertio doctores deinde virtutes exin gratias curationum opitulationes gubernationes genera linguarum
clem: Et quosdam quidem posuit Deus in ecclesia primum apostolos, secundo prophetas, exinde doctores, deinde virtutes, exinde gratias curationum, opitulationes, gubernationes, genera linguarum, interpretationes sermonum.
tr: και ους μεν εθετο ο θεος εν τη εκκλησια πρωτον αποστολους δευτερον προφητας τριτον διδασκαλους επειτα δυναμεις ειτα χαρισματα ιαματων αντιληψεις κυβερνησεις γενη γλωσσων
kjv: And God hath set some in the church, first apostles, secondarily prophets, thirdly teachers, after that miracles, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, diversities of tongues.

vulg: numquid omnes apostoli numquid omnes prophetae numquid omnes doctores
clem: Numquid omnes apostoli? numquid omnes prophet? numquid omnes doctores?
tr: μη παντες αποστολοι μη παντες προφηται μη παντες διδασκαλοι μη παντες δυναμεις
kjv: Are all apostles? are all prophets? are all teachers? are all workers of miracles?

vulg: numquid omnes virtutes numquid omnes gratiam habent curationum numquid omnes linguis loquuntur numquid omnes interpretantur
clem: numquid omnes virtutes? numquid omnes gratiam habent curationum? numquid omnes linguis loquuntur? numquid omnes interpretantur?
tr: μη παντες χαρισματα εχουσιν ιαματων μη παντες γλωσσαις λαλουσιν μη παντες διερμηνευουσιν
kjv: Have all the gifts of healing? do all speak with tongues? do all interpret?

vulg: aemulamini autem charismata maiora et adhuc excellentiorem viam vobis demonstro
clem: mulamini autem charismata meliora. Et adhuc excellentiorem viam vobis demonstro.
tr: ζηλουτε δε τα χαρισματα τα κρειττονα και ετι καθ υπερβολην οδον υμιν δεικνυμι
kjv: But covet earnestly the best gifts: and yet shew I unto you a more excellent way.

vulg: si linguis hominum loquar et angelorum caritatem autem non habeam factus sum velut aes sonans aut cymbalum tinniens
clem: Si linguis hominum loquar, et angelorum, caritatem autem non habeam, factus sum velut s sonans, aut cymbalum tinniens.
tr: εαν ταις γλωσσαις των ανθρωπων λαλω και των αγγελων αγαπην δε μη εχω γεγονα χαλκος ηχων η κυμβαλον αλαλαζον
kjv: Though I speak with the tongues of men and of angels, and have not charity, I am become as sounding brass, or a tinkling cymbal.

vulg: et si habuero prophetiam et noverim mysteria omnia et omnem scientiam et habuero omnem fidem ita ut montes transferam caritatem autem non habuero nihil sum
clem: Et si habuero prophetiam, et noverim mysteria omnia, et omnem scientiam: et si habuero omnem fidem ita ut montes transferam, caritatem autem non habuero, nihil sum.
tr: και εαν εχω προφητειαν και ειδω τα μυστηρια παντα και πασαν την γνωσιν και εαν εχω πασαν την πιστιν ωστε ορη μεθιστανειν αγαπην δε μη εχω ουθεν  ουδεν  ειμι
kjv: And though I have the gift of prophecy, and understand all mysteries, and all knowledge; and though I have all faith, so that I could remove mountains, and have not charity, I am nothing.

vulg: et si distribuero in cibos pauperum omnes facultates meas et si tradidero corpus meum ut ardeam caritatem autem non habuero nihil mihi prodest
clem: Et si distribuero in cibos pauperum omnes facultates meas, et si tradidero corpus meum ita ut ardeam, caritatem autem non habuero, nihil mihi prodest.
tr: και εαν ψωμισω παντα τα υπαρχοντα μου και εαν παραδω το σωμα μου ινα καυθησωμαι αγαπην δε μη εχω ουδεν ωφελουμαι
kjv: And though I bestow all my goods to feed the poor, and though I give my body to be burned, and have not charity, it profiteth me nothing.

vulg: caritas patiens est benigna est caritas non aemulatur non agit perperam non inflatur
clem: Caritas patiens est, benigna est. Caritas non mulatur, non agit perperam, non inflatur,
tr: η αγαπη μακροθυμει χρηστευεται η αγαπη ου ζηλοι η αγαπη ου περπερευεται ου φυσιουται
kjv: Charity suffereth long, and is kind; charity envieth not; charity vaunteth not itself, is not puffed up,

vulg: non est ambitiosa non quaerit quae sua sunt non inritatur non cogitat malum
clem: non est ambitiosa, non qurit qu sua sunt, non irritatur, non cogitat malum,
tr: ουκ ασχημονει ου ζητει τα εαυτης ου παροξυνεται ου λογιζεται το κακον
kjv: Doth not behave itself unseemly, seeketh not her own, is not easily provoked, thinketh no evil;

vulg: non gaudet super iniquitatem congaudet autem veritati
clem: non gaudet super iniquitate, congaudet autem veritati:
tr: ου χαιρει επι τη αδικια συγχαιρει δε τη αληθεια
kjv: Rejoiceth not in iniquity, but rejoiceth in the truth;

vulg: omnia suffert omnia credit omnia sperat omnia sustinet
clem: omnia suffert, omnia credit, omnia sperat, omnia sustinet.
tr: παντα στεγει παντα πιστευει παντα ελπιζει παντα υπομενει
kjv: Beareth all things, believeth all things, hopeth all things, endureth all things.

vulg: caritas numquam excidit sive prophetiae evacuabuntur sive linguae cessabunt sive scientia destruetur
clem: Caritas numquam excidit: sive propheti evacuabuntur, sive lingu cessabunt, sive scientia destruetur.
tr: η αγαπη ουδεποτε εκπιπτει ειτε δε προφητειαι καταργηθησονται ειτε γλωσσαι παυσονται ειτε γνωσις καταργηθησεται
kjv: Charity never faileth: but whether there be prophecies, they shall fail; whether there be tongues, they shall cease; whether there be knowledge, it shall vanish away.

vulg: ex parte enim cognoscimus et ex parte prophetamus
clem: Ex parte enim cognoscimus, et ex parte prophetamus.
tr: εκ μερους γαρ γινωσκομεν και εκ μερους προφητευομεν
kjv: For we know in part, and we prophesy in part.

vulg: cum autem venerit quod perfectum est evacuabitur quod ex parte est
clem: Cum autem venerit quod perfectum est, evacuabitur quod ex parte est.
tr: οταν δε ελθη το τελειον τοτε το εκ μερους καταργηθησεται
kjv: But when that which is perfect is come, then that which is in part shall be done away.

vulg: cum essem parvulus loquebar ut parvulus sapiebam ut parvulus cogitabam ut parvulus quando factus sum vir evacuavi quae erant parvuli
clem: Cum essem parvulus, loquebar ut parvulus, cogitabam ut parvulus. Quando autem factus sum vir, evacuavi qu erant parvuli.
tr: οτε ημην νηπιος ως νηπιος ελαλουν ως νηπιος εφρονουν ως νηπιος ελογιζομην οτε δε γεγονα ανηρ κατηργηκα τα του νηπιου
kjv: When I was a child, I spake as a child, I understood as a child, I thought as a child: but when I became a man, I put away childish things.

vulg: videmus nunc per speculum in enigmate tunc autem facie ad faciem nunc cognosco ex parte tunc autem cognoscam sicut et cognitus sum
clem: Videmus nunc per speculum in nigmate: tunc autem facie ad faciem. Nunc cognosco ex parte: tunc autem cognoscam sicut et cognitus sum.
tr: βλεπομεν γαρ αρτι δι εσοπτρου εν αινιγματι τοτε δε προσωπον προς προσωπον αρτι γινωσκω εκ μερους τοτε δε επιγνωσομαι καθως και επεγνωσθην
kjv: For now we see through a glass, darkly; but then face to face: now I know in part; but then shall I know even as also I am known.

vulg: nunc autem manet fides spes caritas tria haec maior autem his est caritas
clem: Nunc autem manent fides, spes, caritas, tria hc: major autem horum est caritas.
tr: νυνι δε μενει πιστις ελπις αγαπη τα τρια ταυτα μειζων δε τουτων η αγαπη
kjv: And now abideth faith, hope, charity, these three; but the greatest of these is charity.

vulg: sectamini caritatem aemulamini spiritalia magis autem ut prophetetis
clem: Sectamini caritatem, mulamini spiritualia: magis autem ut prophetetis.
tr: διωκετε την αγαπην ζηλουτε δε τα πνευματικα μαλλον δε ινα προφητευητε
kjv: Follow after charity, and desire spiritual gifts, but rather that ye may prophesy.

vulg: qui enim loquitur lingua non hominibus loquitur sed Deo nemo enim audit Spiritu autem loquitur mysteria
clem: Qui enim loquitur lingua, non hominibus loquitur, sed Deo: nemo enim audit. Spiritu autem loquitur mysteria.
tr: ο γαρ λαλων γλωσση ουκ ανθρωποις λαλει αλλα τω θεω ουδεις γαρ ακουει πνευματι δε λαλει μυστηρια
kjv: For he that speaketh in an unknown tongue speaketh not unto men, but unto God: for no man understandeth him; howbeit in the spirit he speaketh mysteries.

vulg: nam qui prophetat hominibus loquitur aedificationem et exhortationem et consolationes
clem: Nam qui prophetat, hominibus loquitur ad dificationem, et exhortationem, et consolationem.
tr: ο δε προφητευων ανθρωποις λαλει οικοδομην και παρακλησιν και παραμυθιαν
kjv: But he that prophesieth speaketh unto men to edification, and exhortation, and comfort.

vulg: qui loquitur lingua semet ipsum aedificat qui autem prophetat ecclesiam aedificat
clem: Qui loquitur lingua, semetipsum dificat: qui autem prophetat, ecclesiam Dei dificat.
tr: ο λαλων γλωσση εαυτον οικοδομει ο δε προφητευων εκκλησιαν οικοδομει
kjv: He that speaketh in an unknown tongue edifieth himself; but he that prophesieth edifieth the church.

vulg: volo autem omnes vos loqui linguis magis autem prophetare nam maior est qui prophetat quam qui loquitur linguis nisi si forte ut interpretetur ut ecclesia aedificationem accipiat
clem: Volo autem omnes vos loqui linguis: magis autem prophetare. Nam major est qui prophetat, quam qui loquitur linguis; nisi forte interpretetur ut ecclesia dificationem accipiat.
tr: θελω δε παντας υμας λαλειν γλωσσαις μαλλον δε ινα προφητευητε μειζων γαρ ο προφητευων η ο λαλων γλωσσαις εκτος ει μη διερμηνευη ινα η εκκλησια οικοδομην λαβη
kjv: I would that ye all spake with tongues but rather that ye prophesied: for greater is he that prophesieth than he that speaketh with tongues, except he interpret, that the church may receive edifying.

vulg: nunc autem fratres si venero ad vos linguis loquens quid vobis prodero nisi si vobis loquar aut in revelatione aut scientia aut prophetia aut in doctrina
clem: Nunc autem, fratres, si venero ad vos linguis loquens: quid vobis prodero, nisi vobis loquar aut in revelatione, aut in scientia, aut in prophetia, aut in doctrina?
tr: νυνι δε αδελφοι εαν ελθω προς υμας γλωσσαις λαλων τι υμας ωφελησω εαν μη υμιν λαλησω η εν αποκαλυψει η εν γνωσει η εν προφητεια η εν διδαχη
kjv: Now, brethren, if I come unto you speaking with tongues, what shall I profit you, except I shall speak to you either by revelation, or by knowledge, or by prophesying, or by doctrine?

vulg: tamen quae sine anima sunt vocem dantia sive tibia sive cithara nisi distinctionem sonituum dederint quomodo scietur quod canitur aut quod citharizatur
clem: Tamen qu sine anima sunt vocem dantia, sive tibia, sive cithara; nisi distinctionem sonituum dederint, quomodo scietur id quod canitur, aut quod citharizatur?
tr: ομως τα αψυχα φωνην διδοντα ειτε αυλος ειτε κιθαρα εαν διαστολην τοις φθογγοις μη δω πως γνωσθησεται το αυλουμενον η το κιθαριζομενον
kjv: And even things without life giving sound, whether pipe or harp, except they give a distinction in the sounds, how shall it be known what is piped or harped?

vulg: etenim si incertam vocem det tuba quis parabit se ad bellum
clem: Etenim si incertam vocem det tuba, quis parabit se ad bellum?
tr: και γαρ εαν αδηλον φωνην σαλπιγξ δω τις παρασκευασεται εις πολεμον
kjv: For if the trumpet give an uncertain sound, who shall prepare himself to the battle?

vulg: ita et vos per linguam nisi manifestum sermonem dederitis quomodo scietur id quod dicitur eritis enim in aera loquentes
clem: Ita et vos per linguam nisi manifestum sermonem dederitis: quomodo scietur id quod dicitur? eritis enim in ara loquentes.
tr: ουτως και υμεις δια της γλωσσης εαν μη ευσημον λογον δωτε πως γνωσθησεται το λαλουμενον εσεσθε γαρ εις αερα λαλουντες
kjv: So likewise ye, except ye utter by the tongue words easy to be understood, how shall it be known what is spoken? for ye shall speak into the air.

vulg: tam multa ut puta genera linguarum sunt in mundo et nihil sine voce est
clem: Tam multa, ut puta genera linguarum sunt in hoc mundo: et nihil sine voce est.
tr: τοσαυτα ει τυχοι γενη φωνων εστιν εν κοσμω και ουδεν αυτων   αφωνον
kjv: There are, it may be, so many kinds of voices in the world, and none of them is without signification.

vulg: si ergo nesciero virtutem vocis ero ei cui loquor barbarus et qui loquitur mihi barbarus
clem: Si ergo nesciero virtutem vocis, ero ei, cui loquor, barbarus: et qui loquitur, mihi barbarus.
tr: εαν ουν μη ειδω την δυναμιν της φωνης εσομαι τω λαλουντι βαρβαρος και ο λαλων εν εμοι βαρβαρος
kjv: Therefore if I know not the meaning of the voice, I shall be unto him that speaketh a barbarian, and he that speaketh shall be a barbarian unto me.

vulg: sic et vos quoniam aemulatores estis spirituum ad aedificationem ecclesiae quaerite ut abundetis
clem: Sic et vos, quoniam mulatores estis spirituum, ad dificationem ecclesi qurite ut abundetis.
tr: ουτως και υμεις επει ζηλωται εστε πνευματων προς την οικοδομην της εκκλησιας ζητειτε ινα περισσευητε
kjv: Even so ye, forasmuch as ye are zealous of spiritual gifts, seek that ye may excel to the edifying of the church.

vulg: et ideo qui loquitur lingua oret ut interpretetur
clem: Et ideo qui loquitur lingua, oret ut interpretetur.
tr: διοπερ ο λαλων γλωσση προσευχεσθω ινα διερμηνευη
kjv: Wherefore let him that speaketh in an unknown tongue pray that he may interpret.

vulg: nam si orem lingua spiritus meus orat mens autem mea sine fructu est
clem: Nam si orem lingua, spiritus meus orat, mens autem mea sine fructu est.
tr: εαν γαρ προσευχωμαι γλωσση το πνευμα μου προσευχεται ο δε νους μου ακαρπος εστιν
kjv: For if I pray in an unknown tongue, my spirit prayeth, but my understanding is unfruitful.

vulg: quid ergo est orabo spiritu orabo et mente psallam spiritu psallam et mente
clem: Quid ergo est? Orabo spiritu, orabo et mente: psallam spiritu, psallam et mente.
tr: τι ουν εστιν προσευξομαι τω πνευματι προσευξομαι δε και τω νοι ψαλω τω πνευματι ψαλω δε και τω νοι
kjv: What is it then? I will pray with the spirit, and I will pray with the understanding also: I will sing with the spirit, and I will sing with the understanding also.

vulg: ceterum si benedixeris spiritu qui supplet locum idiotae quomodo dicet amen super tuam benedictionem quoniam quid dicas nescit
clem: Ceterum si benedixeris spiritu, qui supplet locum idiot, quomodo dicet: Amen, super tuam benedictionem? quoniam quid dicas, nescit.
tr: επει εαν ευλογησης τω πνευματι ο αναπληρων τον τοπον του ιδιωτου πως ερει το αμην επι τη ση ευχαριστια επειδη τι λεγεις ουκ οιδεν
kjv: Else when thou shalt bless with the spirit, how shall he that occupieth the room of the unlearned say Amen at thy giving of thanks, seeing he understandeth not what thou sayest?

vulg: nam tu quidem bene gratias agis sed alter non aedificatur
clem: Nam tu quidem bene gratias agis, sed alter non dificatur.
tr: συ μεν γαρ καλως ευχαριστεις αλλ ο ετερος ουκ οικοδομειται
kjv: For thou verily givest thanks well, but the other is not edified.

vulg: gratias ago Deo quod omnium vestrum lingua loquor
clem: Gratias ago Deo meo, quod omnium vestrum lingua loquor.
tr: ευχαριστω τω θεω μου παντων υμων μαλλον γλωσσαις λαλων
kjv: I thank my God, I speak with tongues more than ye all:

vulg: sed in ecclesia volo quinque verba sensu meo loqui ut et alios instruam quam decem milia verborum in lingua
clem: Sed in ecclesia volo quinque verba sensu meo loqui, ut et alios instruam: quam decem millia verborum in lingua.
tr: αλλ εν εκκλησια θελω πεντε λογους δια του νοος μου λαλησαι ινα και αλλους κατηχησω η μυριους λογους εν γλωσση
kjv: Yet in the church I had rather speak five words with my understanding, that by my voice I might teach others also, than ten thousand words in an unknown tongue.

vulg: fratres nolite pueri effici sensibus sed malitia parvuli estote sensibus autem perfecti estote
clem: Fratres, nolite pueri effici sensibus, sed malitia parvuli estote: sensibus autem perfecti estote.
tr: αδελφοι μη παιδια γινεσθε ταις φρεσιν αλλα τη κακια νηπιαζετε ταις δε φρεσιν τελειοι γινεσθε
kjv: Brethren, be not children in understanding: howbeit in malice be ye children, but in understanding be men.

vulg: in lege scriptum est quoniam in aliis linguis et labiis aliis loquar populo huic et nec sic exaudient me dicit Dominus
clem: In lege scriptum est: Quoniam in aliis linguis et labiis aliis loquar populo huic: et nec sic exaudient me, dicit Dominus.
tr: εν τω νομω γεγραπται οτι εν ετερογλωσσοις και εν χειλεσιν ετεροις λαλησω τω λαω τουτω και ουδ ουτως εισακουσονται μου λεγει κυριος
kjv: In the law it is written, With men of other tongues and other lips will I speak unto this people; and yet for all that will they not hear me, saith the Lord.

vulg: itaque linguae in signum sunt non fidelibus sed infidelibus prophetia autem non infidelibus sed fidelibus
clem: Itaque lingu in signum sunt non fidelibus, sed infidelibus: propheti autem non infidelibus, sed fidelibus.
tr: ωστε αι γλωσσαι εις σημειον εισιν ου τοις πιστευουσιν αλλα τοις απιστοις η δε προφητεια ου τοις απιστοις αλλα τοις πιστευουσιν
kjv: Wherefore tongues are for a sign, not to them that believe, but to them that believe not: but prophesying serveth not for them that believe not, but for them which believe.

vulg: si ergo conveniat universa ecclesia in unum et omnes linguis loquantur intrent autem idiotae aut infideles nonne dicent quod insanitis
clem: Si ergo conveniat universa ecclesia in unum, et omnes linguis loquantur, intrent autem idiot, aut infideles: nonne dicent quod insanitis?
tr: εαν ουν συνελθη η εκκλησια ολη επι το αυτο και παντες γλωσσαις λαλωσιν εισελθωσιν δε ιδιωται η απιστοι ουκ ερουσιν οτι μαινεσθε
kjv: If therefore the whole church be come together into one place, and all speak with tongues, and there come in those that are unlearned, or unbelievers, will they not say that ye are mad?

vulg: si autem omnes prophetent intret autem quis infidelis vel idiota convincitur ab omnibus diiudicatur ab omnibus
clem: Si autem omnes prophetent, intret autem quis infidelis, vel idiota, convincitur ab omnibus, dijudicatur ab omnibus:
tr: εαν δε παντες προφητευωσιν εισελθη δε τις απιστος η ιδιωτης ελεγχεται υπο παντων ανακρινεται υπο παντων
kjv: But if all prophesy, and there come in one that believeth not, or one unlearned, he is convinced of all, he is judged of all:

vulg: occulta cordis eius manifesta fiunt et ita cadens in faciem adorabit Deum pronuntians quod vere Deus in vobis est
clem: occulta cordis ejus manifesta fiunt: et ita cadens in faciem adorabit Deum, pronuntians quod vere Deus in vobis sit.
tr: και ουτως τα κρυπτα της καρδιας αυτου φανερα γινεται και ουτως πεσων επι προσωπον προσκυνησει τω θεω απαγγελλων οτι ο θεος οντως εν υμιν εστιν
kjv: And thus are the secrets of his heart made manifest; and so falling down on his face he will worship God, and report that God is in you of a truth.

vulg: quid ergo est fratres cum convenitis unusquisque vestrum psalmum habet doctrinam habet apocalypsin habet linguam habet interpretationem habet omnia ad aedificationem fiant
clem: Quid ergo est, fratres? Cum convenitis, unusquisque vestrum psalmum habet, doctrinam habet, apocalypsim habet, linguam habet, interpretationem habet: omnia ad dificationem fiant.
tr: τι ουν εστιν αδελφοι οταν συνερχησθε εκαστος υμων ψαλμον εχει διδαχην εχει γλωσσαν εχει αποκαλυψιν εχει ερμηνειαν εχει παντα προς οικοδομην γενεσθω
kjv: How is it then, brethren? when ye come together, every one of you hath a psalm, hath a doctrine, hath a tongue, hath a revelation, hath an interpretation. Let all things be done unto edifying.

vulg: sive lingua quis loquitur secundum duos aut ut multum tres et per partes et unus interpretetur
clem: Sive lingua quis loquitur, secundum duos, aut ut multum tres, et per partes, et unus interpretatur.
tr: ειτε γλωσση τις λαλει κατα δυο η το πλειστον τρεις και ανα μερος και εις διερμηνευετω
kjv: If any man speak in an unknown tongue, let it be by two, or at the most by three, and that by course; and let one interpret.

vulg: si autem non fuerit interpres taceat in ecclesia sibi autem loquatur et Deo
clem: Si autem non fuerit interpres, taceat in ecclesia: sibi autem loquatur, et Deo.
tr: εαν δε μη η διερμηνευτης σιγατω εν εκκλησια εαυτω δε λαλειτω και τω θεω
kjv: But if there be no interpreter, let him keep silence in the church; and let him speak to himself, and to God.

vulg: prophetae duo aut tres dicant et ceteri diiudicent
clem: Prophet autem duo, aut tres dicant, et ceteri dijudicent.
tr: προφηται δε δυο η τρεις λαλειτωσαν και οι αλλοι διακρινετωσαν
kjv: Let the prophets speak two or three, and let the other judge.

vulg: quod si alii revelatum fuerit sedenti prior taceat
clem: Quod si alii revelatum fuerit sedenti, prior taceat.
tr: εαν δε αλλω αποκαλυφθη καθημενω ο πρωτος σιγατω
kjv: If any thing be revealed to another that sitteth by, let the first hold his peace.

vulg: potestis enim omnes per singulos prophetare ut omnes discant et omnes exhortentur
clem: Potestis enim omnes per singulos prophetare: ut omnes discant, et omnes exhortentur:
tr: δυνασθε γαρ καθ ενα παντες προφητευειν ινα παντες μανθανωσιν και παντες παρακαλωνται
kjv: For ye may all prophesy one by one, that all may learn, and all may be comforted.

vulg: et spiritus prophetarum prophetis subiecti sunt
clem: et spiritus prophetarum prophetis subjecti sunt.
tr: και πνευματα προφητων προφηταις υποτασσεται
kjv: And the spirits of the prophets are subject to the prophets.

vulg: non enim est dissensionis Deus sed pacis sicut in omnibus ecclesiis sanctorum
clem: Non enim est dissensionis Deus, sed pacis: sicut et in omnibus ecclesiis sanctorum doceo.
tr: ου γαρ εστιν ακαταστασιας ο θεος αλλ ειρηνης ως εν πασαις ταις εκκλησιαις των αγιων
kjv: For God is not the author of confusion, but of peace, as in all churches of the saints.

vulg: mulieres in ecclesiis taceant non enim permittitur eis loqui sed subditas esse sicut et lex dicit
clem: Mulieres in ecclesiis taceant, non enim permittitur eis loqui, sed subditas esse, sicut et lex dicit.
tr: αι γυναικες υμων εν ταις εκκλησιαις σιγατωσαν ου γαρ επιτετραπται αυταις λαλειν αλλ υποτασσεσθαι καθως και ο νομος λεγει
kjv: Let your women keep silence in the churches: for it is not permitted unto them to speak; but they are commanded to be under obedience as also saith the law.

vulg: si quid autem volunt discere domi viros suos interrogent turpe est enim mulieri loqui in ecclesia
clem: Si quid autem volunt discere, domi viros suos interrogent. Turpe est enim mulieri loqui in ecclesia.
tr: ει δε τι μαθειν θελουσιν εν οικω τους ιδιους ανδρας επερωτατωσαν αισχρον γαρ εστιν γυναιξιν εν εκκλησια λαλειν
kjv: And if they will learn any thing, let them ask their husbands at home: for it is a shame for women to speak in the church.

vulg: an a vobis verbum Dei processit aut in vos solos pervenit
clem: An a vobis verbum Dei processit? aut in vos solos pervenit?
tr: η αφ υμων ο λογος του θεου εξηλθεν η εις υμας μονους κατηντησεν
kjv: What? came the word of God out from you? or came it unto you only?

vulg: si quis videtur propheta esse aut spiritalis cognoscat quae scribo vobis quia Domini sunt mandata
clem: Si quis videtur propheta esse, aut spiritualis, cognoscat qu scribo vobis, quia Domini sunt mandata.
tr: ει τις δοκει προφητης ειναι η πνευματικος επιγινωσκετω α γραφω υμιν οτι του κυριου εισιν εντολαι
kjv: If any man think himself to be a prophet, or spiritual, let him acknowledge that the things that I write unto you are the commandments of the Lord.

vulg: si quis autem ignorat ignorabitur
clem: Si quis autem ignorat, ignorabitur.
tr: ει δε τις αγνοει αγνοειτω
kjv: But if any man be ignorant, let him be ignorant.

vulg: itaque fratres aemulamini prophetare et loqui linguis nolite prohibere
clem: Itaque fratres mulamini prophetare: et loqui linguis nolite prohibere.
tr: ωστε αδελφοι ζηλουτε το προφητευειν και το λαλειν γλωσσαις μη κωλυετε
kjv: Wherefore, brethren, covet to prophesy, and forbid not to speak with tongues.

vulg: omnia autem honeste et secundum ordinem fiant
clem: Omnia autem honeste, et secundum ordinem fiant.
tr: παντα ευσχημονως και κατα ταξιν γινεσθω
kjv: Let all things be done decently and in order.

vulg: notum autem vobis facio fratres evangelium quod praedicavi vobis quod et accepistis in quo et statis
clem: Notum autem vobis facio, fratres, Evangelium, quod prdicavi vobis, quod et accepistis, in quo et statis,
tr: γνωριζω δε υμιν αδελφοι το ευαγγελιον ο ευηγγελισαμην υμιν ο και παρελαβετε εν ω και εστηκατε
kjv: Moreover, brethren, I declare unto you the gospel which I preached unto you, which also ye have received, and wherein ye stand;

vulg: per quod et salvamini qua ratione praedicaverim vobis si tenetis nisi si frustra credidistis
clem: per quod et salvamini: qua ratione prdicaverim vobis, si tenetis, nisi frustra credidistis.
tr: δι ου και σωζεσθε τινι λογω ευηγγελισαμην υμιν ει κατεχετε εκτος ει μη εικη επιστευσατε
kjv: By which also ye are saved, if ye keep in memory what I preached unto you, unless ye have believed in vain.

vulg: tradidi enim vobis in primis quod et accepi quoniam Christus mortuus est pro peccatis nostris secundum scripturas
clem: Tradidi enim vobis in primis quod et accepi: quoniam Christus mortuus est pro peccatis nostris secundum Scripturas:
tr: παρεδωκα γαρ υμιν εν πρωτοις ο και παρελαβον οτι χριστος απεθανεν υπερ των αμαρτιων ημων κατα τας γραφας
kjv: For I delivered unto you first of all that which I also received, how that Christ died for our sins according to the scriptures;

vulg: et quia sepultus est et quia resurrexit tertia die secundum scripturas
clem: et quia sepultus est, et quia resurrexit tertia die secundum Scripturas:
tr: και οτι εταφη και οτι εγηγερται τη τριτη ημερα κατα τας γραφας
kjv: And that he was buried, and that he rose again the third day according to the scriptures:

vulg: et quia visus est Cephae et post haec undecim
clem: et quia visus est Ceph, et post hoc undecim:
tr: και οτι ωφθη κηφα ειτα τοις δωδεκα
kjv: And that he was seen of Cephas, then of the twelve:

vulg: deinde visus est plus quam quingentis fratribus simul ex quibus multi manent usque adhuc quidam autem dormierunt
clem: deinde visus est plus quam quingentis fratribus simul: ex quibus multi manent usque adhuc, quidam autem dormierunt:
tr: επειτα ωφθη επανω πεντακοσιοις αδελφοις εφαπαξ εξ ων οι πλειους μενουσιν εως αρτι τινες δε και εκοιμηθησαν
kjv: After that, he was seen of above five hundred brethren at once; of whom the greater part remain unto this present, but some are fallen asleep.

vulg: deinde visus est Iacobo deinde apostolis omnibus
clem: deinde visus est Jacobo, deinde Apostolis omnibus:
tr: επειτα ωφθη ιακωβω ειτα τοις αποστολοις πασιν
kjv: After that, he was seen of James; then of all the apostles.

vulg: novissime autem omnium tamquam abortivo visus est et mihi
clem: novissime autem omnium tamquam abortivo, visus est et mihi.
tr: εσχατον δε παντων ωσπερει τω εκτρωματι ωφθη καμοι
kjv: And last of all he was seen of me also, as of one born out of due time.

vulg: ego enim sum minimus apostolorum qui non sum dignus vocari apostolus quoniam persecutus sum ecclesiam Dei
clem: Ego enim sum minimus Apostolorum, qui non sum dignus vocari Apostolus, quoniam persecutus sum ecclesiam Dei.
tr: εγω γαρ ειμι ο ελαχιστος των αποστολων ος ουκ ειμι ικανος καλεισθαι αποστολος διοτι εδιωξα την εκκλησιαν του θεου
kjv: For I am the least of the apostles, that am not meet to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the church of God.

vulg: gratia autem Dei sum id quod sum et gratia eius in me vacua non fuit sed abundantius illis omnibus laboravi non ego autem sed gratia Dei mecum
clem: Gratia autem Dei sum id quod sum, et gratia ejus in me vacua non fuit, sed abundantius illis omnibus laboravi: non ego autem, sed gratia Dei mecum:
tr: χαριτι δε θεου ειμι ο ειμι και η χαρις αυτου η εις εμε ου κενη εγενηθη αλλα περισσοτερον αυτων παντων εκοπιασα ουκ εγω δε αλλ η χαρις του θεου η συν εμοι
kjv: But by the grace of God I am what I am: and his grace which was bestowed upon me was not in vain; but I laboured more abundantly than they all: yet not I, but the grace of God which was with me.

vulg: sive enim ego sive illi sic praedicamus et sic credidistis
clem: sive enim ego, sive illi: sic prdicamus, et sic credidistis.
tr: ειτε ουν εγω ειτε εκεινοι ουτως κηρυσσομεν και ουτως επιστευσατε
kjv: Therefore whether it were I or they, so we preach, and so ye believed.

vulg: si autem Christus praedicatur quod resurrexit a mortuis quomodo quidam dicunt in vobis quoniam resurrectio mortuorum non est
clem: Si autem Christus prdicatur quod resurrexit a mortuis, quomodo quidam dicunt in vobis, quoniam resurrectio mortuorum non est?
tr: ει δε χριστος κηρυσσεται οτι εκ νεκρων εγηγερται πως λεγουσιν τινες εν υμιν οτι αναστασις νεκρων ουκ εστιν
kjv: Now if Christ be preached that he rose from the dead, how say some among you that there is no resurrection of the dead?

vulg: si autem resurrectio mortuorum non est neque Christus resurrexit
clem: Si autem resurrectio mortuorum non est: neque Christus resurrexit.
tr: ει δε αναστασις νεκρων ουκ εστιν ουδε χριστος εγηγερται
kjv: But if there be no resurrection of the dead, then is Christ not risen:

vulg: si autem Christus non resurrexit inanis est ergo praedicatio nostra inanis est et fides vestra
clem: Si autem Christus non resurrexit, inanis est ergo prdicatio nostra, inanis est et fides vestra:
tr: ει δε χριστος ουκ εγηγερται κενον αρα το κηρυγμα ημων κενη δε και η πιστις υμων
kjv: And if Christ be not risen, then is our preaching vain, and your faith is also vain.

vulg: invenimur autem et falsi testes Dei quoniam testimonium diximus adversus Deum quod suscitaverit Christum quem non suscitavit si mortui non resurgunt
clem: invenimur autem et falsi testes Dei: quoniam testimonium diximus adversus Deum quod suscitaverit Christum, quem non suscitavit, si mortui non resurgunt.
tr: ευρισκομεθα δε και ψευδομαρτυρες του θεου οτι εμαρτυρησαμεν κατα του θεου οτι ηγειρεν τον χριστον ον ουκ ηγειρεν ειπερ αρα νεκροι ουκ εγειρονται
kjv: Yea, and we are found false witnesses of God; because we have testified of God that he raised up Christ: whom he raised not up, if so be that the dead rise not.

vulg: nam si mortui non resurgunt neque Christus resurrexit
clem: Nam si mortui non resurgunt, neque Christus resurrexit.
tr: ει γαρ νεκροι ουκ εγειρονται ουδε χριστος εγηγερται
kjv: For if the dead rise not, then is not Christ raised:

vulg: quod si Christus non resurrexit vana est fides vestra adhuc enim estis in peccatis vestris
clem: Quod si Christus non resurrexit, vana est fides vestra: adhuc enim estis in peccatis vestris.
tr: ει δε χριστος ουκ εγηγερται ματαια η πιστις υμων ετι εστε εν ταις αμαρτιαις υμων
kjv: And if Christ be not raised, your faith is vain; ye are yet in your sins.

vulg: ergo et qui dormierunt in Christo perierunt
clem: Ergo et qui dormierunt in Christo, perierunt.
tr: αρα και οι κοιμηθεντες εν χριστω απωλοντο
kjv: Then they also which are fallen asleep in Christ are perished.

vulg: si in hac vita tantum in Christo sperantes sumus miserabiliores sumus omnibus hominibus
clem: Si in hac vita tantum in Christo sperantes sumus, miserabiliores sumus omnibus hominibus.
tr: ει εν τη ζωη ταυτη ηλπικοτες εσμεν εν χριστω μονον ελεεινοτεροι παντων ανθρωπων εσμεν
kjv: If in this life only we have hope in Christ, we are of all men most miserable.

vulg: nunc autem Christus resurrexit a mortuis primitiae dormientium
clem: Nunc autem Christus resurrexit a mortuis primiti dormientium,
tr: νυνι δε χριστος εγηγερται εκ νεκρων απαρχη των κεκοιμημενων εγενετο
kjv: But now is Christ risen from the dead, and become the firstfruits of them that slept.

vulg: quoniam enim per hominem mors et per hominem resurrectio mortuorum
clem: quoniam quidem per hominem mors, et per hominem resurrectio mortuorum.
tr: επειδη γαρ δι ανθρωπου ο θανατος και δι ανθρωπου αναστασις νεκρων
kjv: For since by man came death, by man came also the resurrection of the dead.

vulg: et sicut in Adam omnes moriuntur ita et in Christo omnes vivificabuntur
clem: Et sicut in Adam omnes moriuntur, ita et in Christo omnes vivificabuntur.
tr: ωσπερ γαρ εν τω αδαμ παντες αποθνησκουσιν ουτως και εν τω χριστω παντες ζωοποιηθησονται
kjv: For as in Adam all die, even so in Christ shall all be made alive.

vulg: unusquisque autem in suo ordine primitiae Christus deinde hii qui sunt Christi in adventu eius
clem: Unusquisque autem in suo ordine, primiti Christus: deinde ii qui sunt Christi, qui in adventu ejus crediderunt.
tr: εκαστος δε εν τω ιδιω ταγματι απαρχη χριστος επειτα οι χριστου εν τη παρουσια αυτου
kjv: But every man in his own order: Christ the firstfruits; afterward they that are Christ's at his coming.

vulg: deinde finis cum tradiderit regnum Deo et Patri cum evacuaverit omnem principatum et potestatem et virtutem
clem: Deinde finis: cum tradiderit regnum Deo et Patri, cum evacuaverit omnem principatum, et potestatem, et virtutem.
tr: ειτα το τελος οταν παραδω την βασιλειαν τω θεω και πατρι οταν καταργηση πασαν αρχην και πασαν εξουσιαν και δυναμιν
kjv: Then cometh the end, when he shall have delivered up the kingdom to God, even the Father; when he shall have put down all rule and all authority and power.

vulg: oportet autem illum regnare donec ponat omnes inimicos sub pedibus eius
clem: Oportet autem illum regnare donec ponat omnes inimicos sub pedibus ejus.
tr: δει γαρ αυτον βασιλευειν αχρις ου αν θη παντας τους εχθρους υπο τους ποδας αυτου
kjv: For he must reign, till he hath put all enemies under his feet.

vulg: novissima autem inimica destruetur mors omnia enim subiecit sub pedibus eius cum autem dicat
clem: Novissima autem inimica destruetur mors: omnia enim subjecit pedibus ejus. Cum autem dicat:
tr: εσχατος εχθρος καταργειται ο θανατος
kjv: The last enemy that shall be destroyed is death.
