vulg: omnia subiecta sunt sine dubio praeter eum qui subiecit ei omnia
clem: Omnia subjecta sunt ei, sine dubio prter eum qui subjecit ei omnia.
tr: παντα γαρ υπεταξεν υπο τους ποδας αυτου οταν δε ειπη οτι παντα υποτετακται δηλον οτι εκτος του υποταξαντος αυτω τα παντα
kjv: For he hath put all things under his feet. But when he saith all things are put under him, it is manifest that he is excepted, which did put all things under him.

vulg: cum autem subiecta fuerint illi omnia tunc ipse Filius subiectus erit illi qui sibi subiecit omnia ut sit Deus omnia in omnibus
clem: Cum autem subjecta fuerint illi omnia: tunc et ipse Filius subjectus erit ei, qui subjecit sibi omnia, ut sit Deus omnia in omnibus.
tr: οταν δε υποταγη αυτω τα παντα τοτε και αυτος ο υιος υποταγησεται τω υποταξαντι αυτω τα παντα ινα η ο θεος τα παντα εν πασιν
kjv: And when all things shall be subdued unto him, then shall the Son also himself be subject unto him that put all things under him, that God may be all in all.

vulg: alioquin quid facient qui baptizantur pro mortuis si omnino mortui non resurgunt ut quid et baptizantur pro illis
clem: Alioquin quid facient qui baptizantur pro mortuis, si omnino mortui non resurgunt? ut quid et baptizantur pro illis?
tr: επει τι ποιησουσιν οι βαπτιζομενοι υπερ των νεκρων ει ολως νεκροι ουκ εγειρονται τι και βαπτιζονται υπερ των νεκρων
kjv: Else what shall they do which are baptized for the dead, if the dead rise not at all? why are they then baptized for the dead?

vulg: ut quid et nos periclitamur omni hora
clem: ut quid et nos periclitamur omni hora?
tr: τι και ημεις κινδυνευομεν πασαν ωραν
kjv: And why stand we in jeopardy every hour?

vulg: cotidie morior per vestram gloriam fratres quam habeo in Christo Iesu Domino nostro
clem: Quotidie morior per vestram gloriam, fratres, quam habeo in Christo Jesu Domino nostro.
tr: καθ ημεραν αποθνησκω νη την ημετεραν  υμετεραν  καυχησιν ην εχω εν χριστω ιησου τω κυριω ημων
kjv: I protest by your rejoicing which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I die daily.

vulg: si secundum hominem ad bestias pugnavi Ephesi quid mihi prodest si mortui non resurgunt manducemus et bibamus cras enim moriemur
clem: Si secundum hominem ad bestias pugnavi Ephesi, quid mihi prodest, si mortui non resurgunt? Manducemus, et bibamus, cras enim moriemur.
tr: ει κατα ανθρωπον εθηριομαχησα εν εφεσω τι μοι το οφελος ει νεκροι ουκ εγειρονται φαγωμεν και πιωμεν αυριον γαρ αποθνησκομεν
kjv: If after the manner of men I have fought with beasts at Ephesus, what advantageth it me, if the dead rise not? let us eat and drink; for to morrow we die.

vulg: nolite seduci corrumpunt mores bonos conloquia mala
clem: Nolite seduci: corrumpunt mores bonos colloquia mala.
tr: μη πλανασθε φθειρουσιν ηθη χρησθ ομιλιαι κακαι
kjv: Be not deceived: evil communications corrupt good manners.

vulg: evigilate iuste et nolite peccare ignorantiam enim Dei quidam habent ad reverentiam vobis loquor
clem: Evigilate justi, et nolite peccare: ignorantiam enim Dei quidam habent, ad reverentiam vobis loquor.
tr: εκνηψατε δικαιως και μη αμαρτανετε αγνωσιαν γαρ θεου τινες εχουσιν προς εντροπην υμιν λεγω
kjv: Awake to righteousness, and sin not; for some have not the knowledge of God: I speak this to your shame.

vulg: sed dicet aliquis quomodo resurgunt mortui quali autem corpore veniunt
clem: Sed dicet aliquis: Quomodo resurgunt mortui? qualive corpore venient?
tr: αλλ ερει τις πως εγειρονται οι νεκροι ποιω δε σωματι ερχονται
kjv: But some man will say, How are the dead raised up? and with what body do they come?

vulg: insipiens tu quod seminas non vivificatur nisi prius moriatur
clem: Insipiens, tu quod seminas non vivificatur, nisi prius moriatur:
tr: αφρον συ ο σπειρεις ου ζωοποιειται εαν μη αποθανη
kjv: Thou fool, that which thou sowest is not quickened, except it die:

vulg: et quod seminas non corpus quod futurum est seminas sed nudum granum ut puta tritici aut alicuius ceterorum
clem: et quod seminas, non corpus, quod futurum est, seminas, sed nudum granum, ut puta tritici, aut alicujus ceterorum.
tr: και ο σπειρεις ου το σωμα το γενησομενον σπειρεις αλλα γυμνον κοκκον ει τυχοι σιτου η τινος των λοιπων
kjv: And that which thou sowest, thou sowest not that body that shall be, but bare grain, it may chance of wheat, or of some other grain:

vulg: Deus autem dat illi corpus sicut voluit et unicuique seminum proprium corpus
clem: Deus autem dat illi corpus sicut vult: ut unicuique seminum proprium corpus.
tr: ο δε θεος αυτω διδωσιν σωμα καθως ηθελησεν και εκαστω των σπερματων το ιδιον σωμα
kjv: But God giveth it a body as it hath pleased him, and to every seed his own body.

vulg: non omnis caro eadem caro sed alia hominum alia pecorum alia caro volucrum alia autem piscium
clem: Non omnis caro, eadem caro: sed alia quidem hominum, alia vero pecorum, alia volucrum, alia autem piscium.
tr: ου πασα σαρξ η αυτη σαρξ αλλα αλλη μεν σαρξ ανθρωπων αλλη δε σαρξ κτηνων αλλη δε ιχθυων αλλη δε πτηνων
kjv: All flesh is not the same flesh: but there is one kind of flesh of men, another flesh of beasts, another of fishes, and another of birds.

vulg: et corpora caelestia et corpora terrestria sed alia quidem caelestium gloria alia autem terrestrium
clem: Et corpora clestia, et corpora terrestria: sed alia quidem clestium gloria, alia autem terrestrium.
tr: και σωματα επουρανια και σωματα επιγεια αλλ ετερα μεν η των επουρανιων δοξα ετερα δε η των επιγειων
kjv: There are also celestial bodies, and bodies terrestrial: but the glory of the celestial is one, and the glory of the terrestrial is another.

vulg: alia claritas solis alia claritas lunae et alia claritas stellarum stella enim ab stella differt in claritate
clem: Alia claritas solis, alia claritas lun, et alia claritas stellarum. Stella enim a stella differt in claritate:
tr: αλλη δοξα ηλιου και αλλη δοξα σεληνης και αλλη δοξα αστερων αστηρ γαρ αστερος διαφερει εν δοξη
kjv: There is one glory of the sun, and another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars: for one star differeth from another star in glory.

vulg: sic et resurrectio mortuorum seminatur in corruptione surgit in incorruptione
clem: sic et resurrectio mortuorum. Seminatur in corruptione, surget in incorruptione.
tr: ουτως και η αναστασις των νεκρων σπειρεται εν φθορα εγειρεται εν αφθαρσια
kjv: So also is the resurrection of the dead. It is sown in corruption; it is raised in incorruption:

vulg: seminatur in ignobilitate surgit in gloria seminatur in infirmitate surgit in virtute
clem: Seminatur in ignobilitate, surget in gloria: seminatur in infirmitate, surget in virtute:
tr: σπειρεται εν ατιμια εγειρεται εν δοξη σπειρεται εν ασθενεια εγειρεται εν δυναμει
kjv: It is sown in dishonour; it is raised in glory: it is sown in weakness; it is raised in power:

vulg: seminatur corpus animale surgit corpus spiritale si est corpus animale est et spiritale sic et scriptum est
clem: seminatur corpus animale, surget corpus spiritale. Si est corpus animale, est et spiritale, sicut scriptum est:
tr: σπειρεται σωμα ψυχικον εγειρεται σωμα πνευματικον εστιν σωμα ψυχικον και εστιν σωμα πνευματικον
kjv: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body, and there is a spiritual body.

vulg: factus est primus homo Adam in animam viventem novissimus Adam in spiritum vivificantem
clem: Factus est primus homo Adam in animam viventem, novissimus Adam in spiritum vivificantem.
tr: ουτως και γεγραπται εγενετο ο πρωτος ανθρωπος αδαμ εις ψυχην ζωσαν ο εσχατος αδαμ εις πνευμα ζωοποιουν
kjv: And so it is written, The first man Adam was made a living soul; the last Adam was made a quickening spirit.

vulg: sed non prius quod spiritale est sed quod animale est deinde quod spiritale
clem: Sed non prius quod spiritale est, sed quod animale: deinde quod spiritale.
tr: αλλ ου πρωτον το πνευματικον αλλα το ψυχικον επειτα το πνευματικον
kjv: Howbeit that was not first which is spiritual, but that which is natural; and afterward that which is spiritual.

vulg: primus homo de terra terrenus secundus homo de caelo caelestis
clem: Primus homo de terra, terrenus: secundus homo de clo, clestis.
tr: ο πρωτος ανθρωπος εκ γης χοικος ο δευτερος ανθρωπος ο κυριος εξ ουρανου
kjv: The first man is of the earth, earthy; the second man is the Lord from heaven.

vulg: qualis terrenus tales et terreni et qualis caelestis tales et caelestes
clem: Qualis terrenus, tales et terreni: et qualis clestis, tales et clestes.
tr: οιος ο χοικος τοιουτοι και οι χοικοι και οιος ο επουρανιος τοιουτοι και οι επουρανιοι
kjv: As is the earthy, such are they also that are earthy: and as is the heavenly, such are they also that are heavenly.

vulg: igitur sicut portavimus imaginem terreni portemus et imaginem caelestis
clem: Igitur, sicut portavimus imaginem terreni, portemus et imaginem clestis.
tr: και καθως εφορεσαμεν την εικονα του χοικου φορεσομεν και την εικονα του επουρανιου
kjv: And as we have borne the image of the earthy, we shall also bear the image of the heavenly.

vulg: hoc autem dico fratres quoniam caro et sanguis regnum Dei possidere non possunt neque corruptio incorruptelam possidebit
clem: Hoc autem dico, fratres: quia caro et sanguis regnum Dei possidere non possunt: neque corruptio incorruptelam possidebit.
tr: τουτο δε φημι αδελφοι οτι σαρξ και αιμα βασιλειαν θεου κληρονομησαι ου δυνανται ουδε η φθορα την αφθαρσιαν κληρονομει
kjv: Now this I say, brethren, that flesh and blood cannot inherit the kingdom of God; neither doth corruption inherit incorruption.

vulg: ecce mysterium vobis dico omnes quidem resurgemus sed non omnes inmutabimur
clem: Ecce mysterium vobis dico: omnes quidem resurgemus, sed non omnes immutabimur.
tr: ιδου μυστηριον υμιν λεγω παντες μεν ου κοιμηθησομεθα παντες δε αλλαγησομεθα
kjv: Behold, I shew you a mystery; We shall not all sleep, but we shall all be changed,

vulg: in momento in ictu oculi in novissima tuba canet enim et mortui resurgent incorrupti et nos inmutabimur
clem: In momento, in ictu oculi, in novissima tuba: canet enim tuba, et mortui resurgent incorrupti: et nos immutabimur.
tr: εν ατομω εν ριπη οφθαλμου εν τη εσχατη σαλπιγγι σαλπισει γαρ και οι νεκροι εγερθησονται αφθαρτοι και ημεις αλλαγησομεθα
kjv: In a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trump: for the trumpet shall sound, and the dead shall be raised incorruptible, and we shall be changed.

vulg: oportet enim corruptibile hoc induere incorruptelam et mortale hoc induere inmortalitatem
clem: Oportet enim corruptibile hoc induere incorruptionem: et mortale hoc induere immortalitatem.
tr: δει γαρ το φθαρτον τουτο ενδυσασθαι αφθαρσιαν και το θνητον τουτο ενδυσασθαι αθανασιαν
kjv: For this corruptible must put on incorruption, and this mortal must put on immortality.

vulg: cum autem mortale hoc induerit inmortalitatem tunc fiet sermo qui scriptus est absorta est mors in victoria
clem: Cum autem mortale hoc induerit immortalitatem, tunc fiet sermo, qui scriptus est: Absorpta est mors in victoria.
tr: οταν δε το φθαρτον τουτο ενδυσηται αφθαρσιαν και το θνητον τουτο ενδυσηται αθανασιαν τοτε γενησεται ο λογος ο γεγραμμενος κατεποθη ο θανατος εις νικος
kjv: So when this corruptible shall have put on incorruption, and this mortal shall have put on immortality, then shall be brought to pass the saying that is written, Death is swallowed up in victory.

vulg: ubi est mors victoria tua ubi est mors stimulus tuus
clem: Ubi est mors victoria tua? ubi est mors stimulus tuus?
tr: που σου θανατε το κεντρον που σου αδη το νικος
kjv: O death, where is thy sting? O grave, where is thy victory?

vulg: stimulus autem mortis peccatum est virtus vero peccati lex
clem: Stimulus autem mortis peccatum est: virtus vero peccati lex.
tr: το δε κεντρον του θανατου η αμαρτια η δε δυναμις της αμαρτιας ο νομος
kjv: The sting of death is sin; and the strength of sin is the law.

vulg: Deo autem gratias qui dedit nobis victoriam per Dominum nostrum Iesum Christum
clem: Deo autem gratias, qui dedit nobis victoriam per Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum.
tr: τω δε θεω χαρις τω διδοντι ημιν το νικος δια του κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου
kjv: But thanks be to God, which giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

vulg: itaque fratres mei dilecti stabiles estote et inmobiles abundantes in opere Domini semper scientes quod labor vester non est inanis in Domino
clem: Itaque fratres mei dilecti, stabiles estote, et immobiles: abundantes in opere Domini semper, scientes quod labor vester non est inanis in Domino.
tr: ωστε αδελφοι μου αγαπητοι εδραιοι γινεσθε αμετακινητοι περισσευοντες εν τω εργω του κυριου παντοτε ειδοτες οτι ο κοπος υμων ουκ εστιν κενος εν κυριω
kjv: Therefore, my beloved brethren, be ye stedfast, unmoveable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, forasmuch as ye know that your labour is not in vain in the Lord.

vulg: de collectis autem quae fiunt in sanctos sicut ordinavi ecclesiis Galatiae ita et vos facite
clem: De collectis autem, qu fiunt in sanctos, sicut ordinavi ecclesiis Galati, ita et vos facite.
tr: περι δε της λογιας της εις τους αγιους ωσπερ διεταξα ταις εκκλησιαις της γαλατιας ουτως και υμεις ποιησατε
kjv: Now concerning the collection for the saints, as I have given order to the churches of Galatia, even so do ye.

vulg: per unam sabbati unusquisque vestrum apud se ponat recondens quod ei beneplacuerit ut non cum venero tunc collectae fiant
clem: Per unam sabbati unusquisque vestrum apud se seponat, recondens quod ei bene placuerit: ut non, cum venero, tunc collect fiant.
tr: κατα μιαν σαββατων εκαστος υμων παρ εαυτω τιθετω θησαυριζων ο τι αν ευοδωται ινα μη οταν ελθω τοτε λογιαι γινωνται
kjv: Upon the first day of the week let every one of you lay by him in store, as God hath prospered him, that there be no gatherings when I come.

vulg: cum autem praesens fuero quos probaveritis per epistulas hos mittam perferre gratiam vestram in Hierusalem
clem: Cum autem prsens fuero, quos probaveritis per epistolas, hos mittam perferre gratiam vestram in Jerusalem.
tr: οταν δε παραγενωμαι ους εαν δοκιμασητε δι επιστολων τουτους πεμψω απενεγκειν την χαριν υμων εις ιερουσαλημ
kjv: And when I come, whomsoever ye shall approve by your letters, them will I send to bring your liberality unto Jerusalem.

vulg: quod si dignum fuerit ut et ego eam mecum ibunt
clem: Quod si dignum fuerit ut et ego eam, mecum ibunt.
tr: εαν δε η αξιον του καμε πορευεσθαι συν εμοι πορευσονται
kjv: And if it be meet that I go also, they shall go with me.

vulg: veniam autem ad vos cum Macedoniam pertransiero nam Macedoniam pertransibo
clem: Veniam autem ad vos, cum Macedoniam pertransiero: nam Macedoniam pertransibo.
tr: ελευσομαι δε προς υμας οταν μακεδονιαν διελθω μακεδονιαν γαρ διερχομαι
kjv: Now I will come unto you, when I shall pass through Macedonia: for I do pass through Macedonia.

vulg: apud vos autem forsitan manebo vel etiam hiemabo ut vos me deducatis quocumque iero
clem: Apud vos autem forsitan manebo, vel etiam hiemabo: ut vos me deducatis quocumque iero.
tr: προς υμας δε τυχον παραμενω η και παραχειμασω ινα υμεις με προπεμψητε ου εαν πορευωμαι
kjv: And it may be that I will abide, yea, and winter with you, that ye may bring me on my journey whithersoever I go.

vulg: nolo enim vos modo in transitu videre spero enim me aliquantum temporis manere apud vos si Dominus permiserit
clem: Nolo enim vos modo in transitu videre, spero enim me aliquantulum temporis manere apud vos, si Dominus permiserit.
tr: ου θελω γαρ υμας αρτι εν παροδω ιδειν ελπιζω δε χρονον τινα επιμειναι προς υμας εαν ο κυριος επιτρεπη
kjv: For I will not see you now by the way; but I trust to tarry a while with you, if the Lord permit.

vulg: permanebo autem Ephesi usque ad pentecosten
clem: Permanebo autem Ephesi usque ad Pentecosten.
tr: επιμενω δε εν εφεσω εως της πεντηκοστης
kjv: But I will tarry at Ephesus until Pentecost.

vulg: ostium enim mihi apertum est magnum et evidens et adversarii multi
clem: Ostium enim mihi apertum est magnum, et evidens: et adversarii multi.
tr: θυρα γαρ μοι ανεωγεν μεγαλη και ενεργης και αντικειμενοι πολλοι
kjv: For a great door and effectual is opened unto me, and there are many adversaries.

vulg: si autem venerit Timotheus videte ut sine timore sit apud vos opus enim Domini operatur sicut et ego
clem: Si autem venerit Timotheus, videte ut sine timore sit apud vos: opus enim Domini operatur, sicut et ego.
tr: εαν δε ελθη τιμοθεος βλεπετε ινα αφοβως γενηται προς υμας το γαρ εργον κυριου εργαζεται ως και εγω
kjv: Now if Timotheus come, see that he may be with you without fear: for he worketh the work of the Lord, as I also do.

vulg: ne quis ergo illum spernat deducite autem illum in pace ut veniat ad me expecto enim illum cum fratribus
clem: Ne quis ergo illum spernat: deducite autem illum in pace, ut veniat ad me: exspecto enim illum cum fratribus.
tr: μη τις ουν αυτον εξουθενηση προπεμψατε δε αυτον εν ειρηνη ινα ελθη προς με εκδεχομαι γαρ αυτον μετα των αδελφων
kjv: Let no man therefore despise him: but conduct him forth in peace, that he may come unto me: for I look for him with the brethren.

vulg: de Apollo autem fratre multum rogavi eum ut veniret ad vos cum fratribus et utique non fuit voluntas ut nunc veniret veniet autem cum ei vacuum fuerit
clem: De Apollo autem fratre vobis notum facio, quoniam multum rogavi eum ut veniret ad vos cum fratribus: et utique non fuit voluntas ut nunc veniret: veniet autem, cum ei vacuum fuerit.
tr: περι δε απολλω του αδελφου πολλα παρεκαλεσα αυτον ινα ελθη προς υμας μετα των αδελφων και παντως ουκ ην θελημα ινα νυν ελθη ελευσεται δε οταν ευκαιρηση
kjv: As touching our brother Apollos, I greatly desired him to come unto you with the brethren: but his will was not at all to come at this time; but he will come when he shall have convenient time.

vulg: vigilate state in fide viriliter agite et confortamini
clem: Vigilate, state in fide, viriliter agite, et confortamini.
tr: γρηγορειτε στηκετε εν τη πιστει ανδριζεσθε κραταιουσθε
kjv: Watch ye, stand fast in the faith, quit you like men, be strong.

vulg: omnia vestra in caritate fiant
clem: Omnia vestra in caritate fiant.
tr: παντα υμων εν αγαπη γινεσθω
kjv: Let all your things be done with charity.

vulg: obsecro autem vos fratres nostis domum Stephanae et Fortunati quoniam sunt primitiae Achaiae et in ministerium sanctorum ordinaverunt se ipsos
clem: Obsecro autem vos fratres, nostis domum Stephan, et Fortunati, et Achaici: quoniam sunt primiti Achai, et in ministerium sanctorum ordinaverunt seipsos:
tr: παρακαλω δε υμας αδελφοι οιδατε την οικιαν στεφανα οτι εστιν απαρχη της αχαιας και εις διακονιαν τοις αγιοις εταξαν εαυτους
kjv: I beseech you, brethren, (ye know the house of Stephanas, that it is the firstfruits of Achaia, and that they have addicted themselves to the ministry of the saints,)

vulg: ut et vos subditi sitis eiusmodi et omni cooperanti et laboranti
clem: ut et vos subditi sitis ejusmodi, et omni cooperanti, et laboranti.
tr: ινα και υμεις υποτασσησθε τοις τοιουτοις και παντι τω συνεργουντι και κοπιωντι
kjv: That ye submit yourselves unto such, and to every one that helpeth with us, and laboureth.

vulg: gaudeo autem in praesentia Stephanae et Fortunati et Achaici quoniam id quod vobis deerat ipsi suppleverunt
clem: Gaudeo autem in prsentia Stephan, et Fortunati, et Achaici: quoniam id, quod vobis deerat, ipsi suppleverunt:
tr: χαιρω δε επι τη παρουσια στεφανα και φουρτουνατου και αχαικου οτι το υμων υστερημα ουτοι ανεπληρωσαν
kjv: I am glad of the coming of Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus: for that which was lacking on your part they have supplied.

vulg: refecerunt enim et meum spiritum et vestrum cognoscite ergo qui eiusmodi sunt
clem: refecerunt enim et meum spiritum, et vestrum. Cognoscite ergo qui hujusmodi sunt.
tr: ανεπαυσαν γαρ το εμον πνευμα και το υμων επιγινωσκετε ουν τους τοιουτους
kjv: For they have refreshed my spirit and yours: therefore acknowledge ye them that are such.

vulg: salutant vos ecclesiae Asiae salutant vos in Domino multum Aquila et Prisca cum domestica sua ecclesia
clem: Salutant vos ecclesi Asi. Salutant vos in Domino multum, Aquila et Priscilla cum domestica sua ecclesia: apud quos et hospitor.
tr: ασπαζονται υμας αι εκκλησιαι της ασιας ασπαζονται υμας εν κυριω πολλα ακυλας και πρισκιλλα συν τη κατ οικον αυτων εκκλησια
kjv: The churches of Asia salute you. Aquila and Priscilla salute you much in the Lord, with the church that is in their house.

vulg: salutant vos fratres omnes salutate invicem in osculo sancto
clem: Salutant vos omnes fratres. Salutate invicem in osculo sancto.
tr: ασπαζονται υμας οι αδελφοι παντες ασπασασθε αλληλους εν φιληματι αγιω
kjv: All the brethren greet you. Greet ye one another with an holy kiss.

vulg: salutatio mea manu Pauli
clem: Salutatio, mea manu Pauli.
tr: ο ασπασμος τη εμη χειρι παυλου
kjv: The salutation of me Paul with mine own hand.

vulg: si quis non amat Dominum Iesum Christum sit anathema maranatha
clem: Si quis non amat Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum, sit anathema, Maran Atha.
tr: ει τις ου φιλει τον κυριον ιησουν χριστον ητω αναθεμα μαραν αθα
kjv: If any man love not the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be Anathema Maranatha.

vulg: gratia Domini Iesu vobiscum
clem: Gratia Domini nostri Jesu Christi vobiscum.
tr: η χαρις του κυριου ιησου χριστου μεθ υμων
kjv: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

vulg: caritas mea cum omnibus vobis in Christo Iesu amen
clem: Caritas mea cum omnibus vobis in Christo Jesu. Amen.
tr: η αγαπη μου μετα παντων υμων εν χριστω ιησου αμην [ προς κορινθιους πρωτη εγραφη απο φιλιππων δια στεφανα και φουρτουνατου και αχαικου και τιμοθεου]
kjv: My love be with you all in Christ Jesus. Amen.
